          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "### 1. 更新 EAS Secrets"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65,
            "text": "在 [Expo Dashboard](https://expo.dev) 的项目设置中："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "text": "1. 进入 \"Secrets\" 页面"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "2. 确保设置了以下环境变量："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69,
            "text": "   - &#96;EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "   - &#96;EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "   - &#96;EXPO_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY&#96; ⚠️ **注意：必须是 &#96;EXPO_PUBLIC_&#96; 前缀**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73,
            "text": "### 2. 重新构建应用"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76,
            "text": "# 使用 EAS Build"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77,
            "text": "eas build --platform android --profile production"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79,
            "text": "# 或本地构建"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80,
            "text": "npx expo prebuild --platform android"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81,
            "text": "cd android"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82,
            "text": "./gradlew assembleRelease"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85,
            "text": "## 测试清单"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87,
            "text": "### Gemini API Key 测试"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88,
            "text": "- [ ] 重新构建应用后，AI 识别功能可以正常工作"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89,
            "text": "- [ ] 如果未设置 API Key，会显示友好的错误提示"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91,
            "text": "### 返回按钮测试"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92,
            "text": "- [ ] 分类管理页面点击返回按钮正常返回到上一页"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93,
            "text": "- [ ] 用途管理页面点击返回按钮正常返回到上一页"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94,
            "text": "- [ ] 账户管理页面点击返回按钮正常返回到上一页"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95,
            "text": "- [ ] 成员管理页面点击返回按钮正常返回到上一页"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96,
            "text": "- [ ] 应用不会退出"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98,
            "text": "### 登录状态保持测试"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99,
            "text": "- [ ] 登录后退出应用（完全关闭）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100,
            "text": "- [ ] 重新打开应用"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101,
            "text": "- [ ] 应该自动保持登录状态，无需重新登录"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102,
            "text": "- [ ] 如果 session 已过期，应该跳转到登录页面"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104,
            "text": "## 相关文件"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106,
            "text": "- &#96;lib/gemini.ts&#96; - Gemini API 客户端初始化"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107,
            "text": "- &#96;lib/gemini-helper.ts&#96; - Gemini API 辅助函数"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108,
            "text": "- &#96;app/_layout.tsx&#96; - 应用路由配置"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109,
            "text": "- &#96;app/login.tsx&#96; - 登录页面（添加 session 检查）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110,
            "text": "- &#96;lib/supabase.ts&#96; - Supabase 客户端配置（&#96;persistSession: true&#96;）"
          }
        ],
        "range": {

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export async function getCurrentUser(forceRefresh: boolean = false): Promise\u003cUser | null\u003e {\n\n\n    // 如果用户记录不存在，尝试创建（可能是新注册的用户，users 表记录还未创建）\n    if (error || !data) {\n      // 尝试创建用户记录\n      // 尝试从 user_metadata 中获取用户名（注册时通过 data 参数传递）\n      const userNameFromMetadata = authUser.user_metadata?.name;\n      const userName = userNameFromMetadata || authUser.email?.split('@')[0] || 'User';\n      \n      const { error: insertError } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .insert({\n          id: authUser.id,\n          email: authUser.email || '',\n          name: userName,\n          current_space_id: null,\n        });\n      \n      if (insertError) {\n        // 如果是重复键错误（用户已存在），静默处理，直接查询\n        const errorCode = String(insertError.code || '');\n        const isDuplicateKey = errorCode === '23505' || \n                               insertError.message?.includes('duplicate key') ||\n                               insertError.message?.includes('unique constraint');\n        \n        // 如果插入失败，可能是记录已存在（并发情况），再次查询\n        const { data: retryData, error: retryError } = await supabase\n          .from('users')\n          .select('*')\n          .eq('id', authUser.id)\n          .maybeSingle();\n        \n        if (retryError || !retryData) {\n          // 只有在不是重复键错误时才记录错误\n          if (!isDuplicateKey) {\n            console.error('Error getting/creating user:', insertError || retryError);\n          }\n          updateCachedUser(null);\n          return null;\n        }\n        \n        // 使用重试查询到的数据\n        const user: User = {\n          id: retryData.id,\n          email: retryData.email,\n          name: retryData.name,\n          spaceId: retryData.current_space_id || null,\n          currentSpaceId: retryData.current_space_id,\n          createdAt: retryData.created_at,\n        };\n        updateCachedUser(user);\n        return user;\n      }\n      \n      // 插入成功，重新查询\n      const { data: newData, error: newError } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select\n\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function HandleInvitationsScreen() {\nconst continueAfterInvitations = async \n\n\n      // 老用户：有空间但没有当前空间\n      if (spaces.length === 1) {\n        // 只有一个空间，自动设置并进入（这就是上次登录的空间）\n        console.log('continueAfterInvitations: Setting single space:', spaces[0].spaceId);\n        await setCurrentSpace(spaces[0].spaceId);\n        \n        // 更新缓存（强制刷新，确保获取最新的currentSpaceId）\n        try {\n          const updatedUser = await getCurrentUser(true);\n          const updatedSpace = updatedUser ? await getCurrentSpace(true) : null;\n          await initializeAuthCache(updatedUser, updatedSpace);\n          console.log('continueAfterInvitations: Cache updated, redirecting to home');\n        } catch (cacheError) {\n          console.warn('continueAfterInvitations: Cache update failed, continuing:', cacheError);\n        }\n        \n        router.replace('/');\n        return;\n      } else {\n        // 多个空间但没有当前空间，跳转到空间选择页面\n        console.log('continueAfterInvitations: Multiple spaces, redirecting to space-select');\n        router.replace('/space-select');\n        return;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error in continueAfterInvitations:', error);\n      // 如果出错，默认跳转到设置家庭页面\n      router.replace('/setup-space');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleAcceptInvitation = async () =\u003e\n;\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export async function signUp(email: string, password: string, householdName?: string, userName?: string): Promise\u003c{ user: User | null; error: Error | null }\u003e {\n\n      \n      // 创建用户记录（不设置 current_space_id，等待首次登录时设置）\n      const { error: userError } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .insert({\n          id: authData.user!.id,  // 使用 ! 断言，因为已经检查过 authData.user 不为 null\n          email: email,\n          name: userNameFinal,\n          current_space_id: null,\n        });\n\n      if (userError) {\n        console.log('User record creation failed (this is expected if email confirmation is required):', userError.code);\n        console.log('Error details:', {\n          code: userError.code,\n          message: userError.message,\n        });\n        \n        // 如果遇到 RLS 策略问题或其他权限问题，说明可能需要邮箱确认后才能创建 users 表记录\n        // 这是正常情况，不抛出错误，返回需要邮箱确认的状态\n        // 用户记录将在首次登录时自动创建\n        if (userError.code === '42501' || \n            userError.message?.includes('row-level security') || \n            userError.message?.includes('permission denied') ||\n            userError.code === '23503' ||\n            userError.message?.includes('foreign key constraint')) {\n          // 返回需要邮箱确认的状态（即使 authData.user 存在，users 表记录也会在登录时创建）\n          return { \n            user: null, \n            error: new Error('EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED') \n          };\n        }\n        \n        // 其他未知错误，也视为需要邮箱确认（保守处理）\n        // 用户记录将在首次登录时自动创建\n        return { \n          user: null, \n          error: new Error('EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED') \n        };\n      }\n\n      const user: User = {\n        id: authData.user!.id,\n      };\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// 创建新空间并加入\nexport async function createSpace(name: string, address?: string): Promise\u003c{ space: Space | null; error: Error | null }\u003e {\n  try {\n    const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n    if (!authUser) {\n      return { space: null, error: new Error('Not authenticated') };\n    }\n\n    // 确保用户记录存在（如果不存在则创建）\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) {\n      // 用户记录不存在，尝试创建\n      const userNameFromMetadata = authUser.user_metadata?.name;\n      const userName = userNameFromMetadata || authUser.email?.split('@')[0] || 'User';\n      \n      const { error: userInsertError } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .insert({\n          id: authUser.id,\n          email: authUser.email || '',\n          name: userName,\n          current_space_id: null,\n        });\n      \n      if (userInsertError) {\n        // 如果创建用户记录失败（可能是 RLS 错误），返回友好错误\n        return { \n          space: null, \n          error: new Error('Please confirm your email first, then try creating a space again.') \n        };\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 验证认证状态\n    const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();\n    if (!session) {\n      console.error('No active session when trying to create space');\n      return { \n        space: null, \n        error: new Error('Not authenticated: Please sign in again') \n      };\n    }\n    \n    // 解析 JWT token 检查 role（用于调试）\n    let tokenRole = 'unknown';\n    try {\n      if (session.access_token) {\n        const tokenParts = session.access_token.split('.');\n        if (tokenParts.length === 3) {\n          const payload = JSON.parse(atob(tokenParts[1]));\n          tokenRole = payload.role || 'unknown';\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.warn('Failed to parse JWT token:', e);\n    }\n    \n    console.log('Session info:', {\n      userId: session.user.id,\n\n}",

        "contents": "export default function EmailConfirmScreen() {\nconst handleEmailConfirmation = async \nasync () =\u003e {\n\n, 3000);\n        }, 1500);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 如果所有方法都失败\n      setStatus('error');\n      setMessage('Invalid confirmation link. Please check your email and try again.');\n      setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n        router.replace('/login');\n      }, 3000);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Email confirmation exception:', error);\n      setStatus('error');\n      setMessage('An error occurred. Please try again.');\n      setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n        router.replace('/login');\n      }, 3000);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 确保 users 表中有用户记录\n  const ensureUserRecord = async (user: any) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      const { data: existingUser } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('id')\n        .eq('id', user.id)\n        .maybeSingle();\n      \n      if (!existingUser) {\n        const userNameFromMetadata = user.user_metadata?.name;\n        const userName = userNameFromMetadata || user.email?.split('@')[0] || 'User';\n        \n        const { error: insertError } = await supabase\n          .from('users')\n          .insert({\n            id: user.id,\n            email: user.email || '',\n            name: userName,\n            current_space_id: null,\n          });\n        \n        if (insertError) {\n          console.error('Error creating user record:', insertError);\n        } else {\n          console.log('User record created successfully');\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error ensuring user record exists:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    \u003cView style={styles.container}\u003e\n      \u003cStatusBar style=\"dark\" /\u003e\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# 禁用 Supabase 邮箱确认功能\n\n## 问题\n注册成功后，登录时遇到错误：&#96;Email not confirmed&#96;\n\n这是因为 Supabase 默认启用了邮箱确认功能，新注册的用户需要先确认邮箱才能登录。\n\n## 解决方案：在 Supabase Dashboard 中禁用邮箱确认\n\n### 步骤：\n\n1. **打开 Supabase Dashboard**\n   - 访问 https://supabase.com/dashboard\n   - 登录并选择你的项目\n\n2. **进入 Authentication 设置**\n   - 点击左侧菜单的 **\"Authentication\"**\n   - 点击 **\"Settings\"** 或 **\"Providers\"**\n\n3. **找到 Email 设置**\n   - 向下滚动找到 **\"Email\"** 或 **\"Email Auth\"** 部分\n   - 找到 **\"Confirm email\"** 或 **\"Enable email confirmations\"** 选项\n\n4. **禁用邮箱确认**\n   - 取消勾选 **\"Enable email confirmations\"** 或 **\"Confirm email\"**\n   - 或者设置为 **\"OFF\"**\n\n5. **保存设置**\n   - 点击 **\"Save\"** 按钮\n\n6. **重新尝试注册和登录**\n   - 现在新用户注册后可以直接登录，无需确认邮箱\n\n## 注意事项\n\n- ⚠️ **生产环境**：建议保持邮箱确认功能启用，以提高安全性\n- ✅ **开发环境**：可以禁用邮箱确认，方便测试\n- 📧 **如果启用了邮箱确认**：用户注册后会收到确认邮件，需要点击邮件中的链接确认邮箱后才能登录\n\n## 替代方案（如果不想禁用邮箱确认）\n\n如果你希望保持邮箱确认功能：\n\n1. 注册后检查邮箱，找到确认邮件\n2. 点击邮件中的确认链接\n3. 确认后即可正常登录\n\n## 验证设置是否生效\n\n禁用邮箱确认后：\n- 新用户注册后可以直接登录\n- 不会再出现 \"Email not confirmed\" 错误\n- 用户注册成功后立即可以访问应用",

        "contents": "export async function signUp(email: string, password: string, householdName?: string, userName?: string): Promise\u003c{ user: User | null; error: Error | null }\u003e {\n\n    if (householdName === undefined) {\n      \n      // 如果启用了邮箱确认，authData.user 可能为 null，但 auth.users 记录已经创建\n      // 我们需要尝试创建 users 表记录\n      if (!authData.user) {\n        // 注册成功，但需要邮箱确认，auth.users 记录已创建但无法获取 user.id\n        // 在这种情况下，用户记录将在邮箱确认时或首次登录时创建\n        // 返回需要邮箱确认的标记\n        return { \n          user: null, \n          error: new Error('EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED') \n        };\n      }\n      \n      \n      // 检查 users 表中是否已存在该用户（以防万一）\n      const { data: existingUser } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('id, current_space_id, name')\n        .eq('id', authData.user!.id)  // 使用 ! 断言，因为已经检查过 authData.user 不为 null\n        .maybeSingle();\n      \n      if (existingUser) {\n        // 用户记录已存在，如果提供了用户名，更新用户的name字段\n        if (userName \u0026\u0026 userName.trim()) {\n          await supabase\n            .from('users')\n            .update({ name: userName.trim() })\n            .eq('id', authData.user!.id);  // 使用 ! 断言，因为已经检查过 authData.user 不为 null\n        }\n        const user: User = {\n          id: authData.user!.id,  // 使用 ! 断言，因为已经检查过 authData.user 不为 null\n          email: email,\n          name: userName \u0026\u0026 userName.trim() ? userName.trim() : undefined,\n          spaceId: existingUser.current_space_id || null, // 返回当前活动的空间ID，如果没有则为 null\n          currentSpaceId: existingUser.current_space_id || undefined,\n        };\n        return { user, error: null };\n      }\n      \n      // 创建用户记录（不设置 current_space_id，等待首次登录时设置）\n}",
        "detailedLines": [

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Supabase 邮件确认配置指南\n\n本指南说明如何配置 Supabase 使用企业邮箱发送确认邮件，并将确认链接包装在邮件中，用户确认后返回到应用登录界面。\n\n## 配置步骤\n\n### 1. 配置 SMTP 设置（使用企业邮箱）\n\n1. **登录 Supabase Dashboard**\n   - 访问 https://supabase.com/dashboard\n   - 选择你的项目\n\n2. **进入 Authentication 设置**\n   - 点击左侧菜单的 **\"Authentication\"**\n   - 点击 **\"Settings\"** 标签\n\n3. **配置 SMTP**\n   - 找到 **\"SMTP Settings\"** 部分\n   - 点击 **\"Enable Custom SMTP\"** 或 **\"Configure SMTP\"**\n   - 填写以下信息：\n     &#96;&#96;&#96;\n     SMTP Host: smtp.app.aim.link (或您的邮件服务器地址)\n     SMTP Port: 587 (或 465 for SSL)\n     SMTP User: no-reply@app.aim.link\n     SMTP Password: [您的邮箱密码]\n     Sender Email: no-reply@app.aim.link\n     Sender Name: Snap Receipt\n     &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   - 点击 **\"Save\"** 保存设置\n\n### 2. 配置邮件模板\n\n1. **进入 Email Templates**\n   - 在 Authentication \u003e Settings 页面\n   - 找到 **\"Email Templates\"** 部分\n\n2. **编辑确认邮件模板**\n   - 选择 **\"Confirm signup\"** 模板\n   - 更新邮件内容，将确认链接包装在邮件中：\n\n   **主题 (Subject):**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Confirm your Snap Receipt account\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   **邮件内容 (Body):**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;html\n   \u003ch2\u003eWelcome to Snap Receipt!\u003c/h2\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eThank you for signing up. Please confirm your email address by clicking the link below:\u003c/p\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003e\u003ca href=\"{{ .ConfirmationURL }}\"\u003eConfirm Email Address\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eOr copy and paste this link into your browser:\u003c/p\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003e{{ .ConfirmationURL }}\u003c/p\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eIf you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.\u003c/p\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eBest regards,\u003cbr\u003eSnap Receipt Team\u003c/p\u003e\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   **注意：** &#96;{{ .ConfirmationURL }}&#96; 是 Supabase 的模板变量，会自动替换为实际的确认链接。\n\n3. **保存模板**\n   - 点击 **\"Save\"** 保存邮件模板\n\n### 3. 配置重定向 URL\n\n1. **进入 URL Configuration**\n   - 在 Authentication \u003e Settings 页面\n   - 找到 **\"URL Configuration\"** 或 **\"Redirect URLs\"** 部分",
        "detailedLines": [

          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "     &#96;&#96;&#96;"

            "text": "     &#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,

          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "### 2. 配置邮件模板"

            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,

          },
          {

            "text": "   - 找到 **\"Email Templates\"** 部分"

            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {

          {

          },

        "contents": "export async function signUp(email: string, password: string, householdName?: string, userName?: string): Promise\u003c{ user: User | null; error: Error | null }\u003e {\n;\n        }\n        \n        \n        // 创建 user_spaces 关联记录\n        const { error: associationError } = await supabase\n          .from('user_spaces')\n          .insert({\n            user_id: authData.user!.id,  // 使用 ! 断言，因为已经检查过 authData.user 不为 null\n            space_id: spaceData.id,\n          });\n\n        if (associationError) {\n          console.warn('Failed to create user_space association:', associationError);\n        }\n        \n        // 创建默认分类和支付账户\n        await createDefaultCategoriesAndAccounts(spaceData.id);\n\n        const user: User = {\n          id: authData.user!.id,  // 使用 ! 断言，因为已经检查过 authData.user 不为 null\n          email: email,\n          name: userName \u0026\u0026 userName.trim() ? userName.trim() : undefined,\n          spaceId: spaceData.id,\n          currentSpaceId: spaceData.id,\n        };\n\n        return { user, error: null };\n      }\n      \n      throw new Error(&#96;Failed to create user and space: ${rpcError.message}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!spaceId) {\n      throw new Error('Registration failed: Space account not created');\n    }\n\n\n    // 创建默认分类和支付账户\n    await createDefaultCategoriesAndAccounts(spaceId);\n\n    // 创建 user_spaces 关联记录（如果不存在）\n    // 注意：RPC 函数应该已经创建了这个记录，但为了保险起见，我们在这里也创建\n    const { error: associationError } = await supabase\n      .from('user_spaces')\n      .insert({\n        user_id: authData.user!.id,  // 使用 ! 断言，因为已经检查过 authData.user 不为 null\n        space_id: spaceId,\n        is_admin: true, // Creator is admin\n      })\n      .select();\n      \n    if (associationError)\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ManagementScreen() {\n\n\n  const openSpaceSwitch = async () =\u003e {\n    await loadSpaces();\n    setShowSpaceSwitch(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateSpace = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!newSpaceName.trim()) {\n      Alert.alert('Error', 'Please enter space name');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setCreating(true);\n      const { space, error } = await createSpace(\n        newSpaceName.trim(),\n        newSpaceAddress.trim() || undefined\n      );\n\n      if (error) {\n        Alert.alert('Error', error.message || 'Failed to create space');\n        setCreating(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      if (space) {\n        setShowCreateModal(false);\n        setNewSpaceName('');\n        setNewSpaceAddress('');\n        await loadSpaces();\n        await loadData();\n        setShowSpaceSwitch(false);\n        Alert.alert('Success', 'Space created successfully');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error creating space:', error);\n      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to create space');\n    } finally {\n      setCreating(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSignOut {\n          text: 'Sign Out',\n          style: 'destructive',\n          onPress: async () =\u003e {\n            try {\n              const { error } = await signOut();\n              if (error) {\n                Alert.alert('Error', error.message || 'Failed to sign out');\n                return;\n              }\n              // 退出成功后跳转到登录页面\n              router.replace('/login');\n            } catch (error) {\n              console.error('Error signing out:', error);\n              Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to sign out');\n            }\n          },\n        },\n      ]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const menuItems = [\n    {\n      id: 'members'\n,\n  ];\n}",

        "contents": "-- 更新 create_user_with_household 函数以支持多家庭系统\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n\n-- 更新函数：为新用户创建家庭和用户记录，同时创建 user_households 关联和设置 current_household_id\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION create_user_with_household(\n  p_user_id UUID,\n  p_email TEXT,\n  p_household_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_user_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL\n)\nRETURNS UUID\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_household_id UUID;\n  v_final_household_name TEXT;\n  v_final_user_name TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- 生成家庭名称\n  IF p_household_name IS NULL OR p_household_name = '' THEN\n    v_final_household_name := split_part(p_email, '@', 1) || '的家庭';\n  ELSE\n    v_final_household_name := p_household_name;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 生成用户名称\n  IF p_user_name IS NULL OR p_user_name = '' THEN\n    v_final_user_name := split_part(p_email, '@', 1);\n  ELSE\n    v_final_user_name := p_user_name;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 创建家庭\n  INSERT INTO households (name)\n  VALUES (v_final_household_name)\n  RETURNING id INTO v_household_id;\n\n  -- 创建用户记录（如果不存在）\n  -- 使用 ON CONFLICT 来处理用户记录已存在的情况\n  INSERT INTO users (id, email, household_id, current_household_id, name)\n  VALUES (p_user_id, p_email, v_household_id, v_household_id, v_final_user_name)\n  ON CONFLICT (id) \n  DO UPDATE SET \n    email = p_email,\n    name = COALESCE(users.name, EXCLUDED.name),\n    household_id = COALESCE(users.household_id, EXCLUDED.household_id),\n    current_household_id = COALESCE(users.current_household_id, EXCLUDED.current_household_id);\n\n  -- 创建 user_households 关联记录（如果不存在）\n  INSERT INTO user_households (user_id, household_id, is_admin)\n  VALUES (p_user_id, v_household_id, TRUE)\n  ON CONFLICT (user_id, household_id) DO NOTHING;\n\n  -- 返回家庭 ID\n  RETURN v_household_id;\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 授予权限：允许已认证用户调用此函数\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION create_user_with_household(UUID, TEXT, TEXT, TEXT) TO authenticated;",

        "contents": "export default function EmailConfirmScreen() {\nconst handleEmailConfirmation = async \n catch (sessionError) {\n          console.error('Error setting session:', sessionError);\n          // 即使 session 设置失败，也尝试继续处理\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 如果有 token_hash，使用 verifyOtp 方法（旧的方式）\n      if (token_hash) {\n        const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n          token_hash,\n          type: type || 'email',\n        });\n\n        if (error) {\n          console.error('Email confirmation error:', error);\n          setStatus('error');\n          setMessage(error.message || 'Failed to confirm email. Please try again.');\n          setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n            router.replace('/login');\n          }, 3000);\n          return;\n        }\n\n        if (data?.user) {\n          // 邮箱确认成功，确保 users 表中有用户记录\n          await ensureUserRecord(data.user);\n          \n          setStatus('success');\n          const isPasswordReset = type === 'recovery';\n          setMessage(\n            isPasswordReset\n              ? 'Password reset link verified! Redirecting to set new password...'\n              : 'Email confirmed successfully! Redirecting to sign in...'\n          );\n          \n          // 如果是密码重置，跳转到设置新密码页面；否则跳转到登录页\n          setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n            if (isPasswordReset) {\n              router.replace('/set-password');\n            } else {\n              router.replace('/login');\n            }\n          }, 2000);\n          return;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 如果以上方法都失败，尝试等待 URL 参数加载\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function createSpace(name: string, address?: string): Promise\u003c{ space: Space | null; error: Error | null }\u003e {\nconst ;\n    if (getUserError || !currentUser) {\n      console.error('Failed to get current user (token may be expired):', getUserError);\n      return { \n        space: null, \n        error: new Error('Authentication token expired. Please sign in again.') \n      };\n    }\n    \n    console.log('Current user verified:', {\n      userId: currentUser.id,\n      email: currentUser.email,\n      matchesAuthUser: currentUser.id === authUser.id,\n    });\n    \n    // 在插入前再次确认 session 和 token\n    const { data: { session: finalSession } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();\n    if (!finalSession) {\n      console.error('Final session check failed - no session');\n      return { \n        space: null, \n        error: new Error('Session lost. Please sign in again.') \n      };\n    }\n    \n    console.log('Final session check before insert:', {\n      hasAccessToken: !!finalSession.access_token,\n      tokenLength: finalSession.access_token?.length || 0,\n      expiresAt: finalSession.expires_at,\n      expiresIn: finalSession.expires_at ? Math.floor((finalSession.expires_at * 1000 - Date.now()) / 1000) : null,\n    });\n    \n    // 尝试使用 RPC 函数插入（如果存在，可以绕过 RLS）\n    // 如果 RPC 函数不存在，会回退到直接插入\n    let spaceData = null;\n    let spaceError = null;\n    \n    // 先尝试使用 RPC 函数（如果存在）\n    const { data: rpcSpaceId, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc('create_space_with_user', {\n      p_space_name: insertData.name,\n      p_space_address: insertData.address || null,\n      p_user_id: currentUser.id,\n    });\n    \n    if (!rpcError \u0026\u0026 rpcSpaceId)\n}",

        "contents": "export async function signUp(email: string, password: string, householdName?: string, userName?: string): Promise\u003c{ user: User | null; error: Error | null }\u003e {\n \n        };\n      }\n\n      const user: User = {\n        id: authData.user!.id,  // 使用 ! 断言，因为已经检查过 authData.user 不为 null\n        email: email,\n        name: userNameFinal,\n        spaceId: null,  // 类型为 string | null\n        currentSpaceId: undefined,  // 类型为 string | undefined\n      };\n      return { user, error: null };\n    }\n\n    // 创建空间和用户记录\n    // 确保 authData.user 存在\n    if (!authData.user) {\n      return { \n        user: null, \n        error: new Error('User authentication failed') \n      };\n    }\n    \n    const spaceNameFinal = householdName || &#96;${email.split('@')[0]}'s Space&#96;;\n    // userNameFinal 已在函数开始处声明（第 338 行），直接使用\n    \n    const { data: spaceId, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc('create_user_with_space', {\n      p_user_id: authData.user!.id,  // 使用 ! 断言，因为已经检查过 authData.user 不为 null\n      p_email: email,\n      p_space_name: spaceNameFinal,\n      p_user_name: userNameFinal,\n    });\n\n    if (rpcError) {\n      console.error('RPC error creating user/space:', rpcError);\n}",

        "contents": "// 创建供应商\nexport async function createSupplier(\n  name: string,\n  isAiRecognized: boolean = false,\n  taxNumber?: string,\n  phone?: string,\n  address?: string\n): Promise\u003cSupplier\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) throw new Error('No space selected');\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('suppliers')\n      .insert({\n        space_id: spaceId,\n        name: name.trim(),\n        tax_number: taxNumber?.trim() || null,\n        phone: phone?.trim() || null,\n        address: address?.trim() || null,\n        is_ai_recognized: isAiRecognized,\n      })\n      .select()\n      .single();\n\n    if (error) throw error;\n\n    return {\n      id: data.id,\n      spaceId: data.space_id,\n      name: data.name,\n      taxNumber: data.tax_number,\n      phone: data.phone,\n      address: data.address,\n      isAiRecognized: data.is_ai_recognized,\n      createdAt: data.created_at,\n      updatedAt: data.updated_at,\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error creating supplier:', error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n// 更新供应商\nexport async function updateSupplier(\n  supplierId: string,\n  updates: {\n    name?: string;\n    taxNumber?: string;\n    phone?: string;\n    address?: string;\n  }\n): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n  \n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "BEGIN\n  -- 获取当前用户ID\n  v_inviter_id := auth.uid();\n  \n  IF v_inviter_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User must be authenticated';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 获取当前用户的 email（从 auth.users，不需要查询 public.users）\n  SELECT email INTO v_inviter_email\n  FROM auth.users\n  WHERE id = v_inviter_id;\n  \n  IF v_inviter_email IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User email not found';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 检查用户是否是管理员（使用 SECURITY DEFINER 函数绕过 RLS）\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM user_households \n    WHERE user_households.user_id = v_inviter_id \n      AND user_households.household_id = p_household_id \n      AND user_households.is_admin = TRUE\n  ) INTO v_is_admin;\n  \n  IF NOT v_is_admin THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only admins can create invitations';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 检查是否已有未过期的邀请\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM household_invitations \n    WHERE household_invitations.household_id = p_household_id \n      AND household_invitations.invitee_email = LOWER(TRIM(p_invitee_email))\n      AND household_invitations.status = 'pending'\n      AND household_invitations.expires_at \u003e NOW()\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'An invitation has already been sent to this email';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 插入邀请（使用 SECURITY DEFINER，完全绕过 RLS）\n  INSERT INTO household_invitations (\n    household_id,\n    inviter_id,\n    inviter_email,\n    invitee_email,\n    token,\n    status,\n    expires_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_household_id,\n    v_inviter_id,\n    v_inviter_email,\n    LOWER(TRIM(p_invitee_email)),\n    p_token,\n    'pending',\n    p_expires_at\n  )\n  RETURNING \n    id,\n    household_id,\n    inviter_id,\n    inviter_email,\n    invitee_email,\n    token,\n    status,\n    expires_at,\n    created_at\n  INTO \n    v_invitation_id,\n    v_invitation_household_id,",
        "detailedLines": [
          {

            "text": "  -- 检查用户是否是管理员（使用 SECURITY DEFINER 函数绕过 RLS）"

            "lineNumber": 77,
            "text": "  SELECT EXISTS ("

            "lineNumber": 78,

        "contents": "BEGIN\n  -- 获取当前用户ID\n  v_inviter_id := auth.uid();\n  \n  IF v_inviter_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User must be authenticated';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 获取当前用户的 email（从 auth.users，不需要查询 public.users）\n  SELECT email INTO v_inviter_email\n  FROM auth.users\n  WHERE id = v_inviter_id;\n  \n  IF v_inviter_email IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User email not found';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 检查用户是否是管理员（只查询 user_households 表）\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM user_households \n    WHERE user_households.user_id = v_inviter_id \n      AND user_households.household_id = p_household_id \n      AND user_households.is_admin = TRUE\n  ) INTO v_is_admin;\n  \n  IF NOT v_is_admin THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only admins can create invitations';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 检查是否已有未过期的邀请\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM household_invitations \n    WHERE household_invitations.household_id = p_household_id \n      AND household_invitations.invitee_email = LOWER(TRIM(p_invitee_email))\n      AND household_invitations.status = 'pending'\n      AND household_invitations.expires_at \u003e NOW()\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'An invitation has already been sent to this email';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 插入邀请（使用 SECURITY DEFINER，完全绕过 RLS）\n  -- 关键修复：使用明确的变量名避免列名歧义\n  INSERT INTO household_invitations (\n    household_id,\n    inviter_id,\n    inviter_email,\n    invitee_email,\n    token,\n    status,\n    expires_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_household_id,\n    v_inviter_id,\n    v_inviter_email,\n    LOWER(TRIM(p_invitee_email)),\n    p_token,\n    'pending',\n    p_expires_at\n  )\n  RETURNING \n    household_invitations.id,",

        "contents": "# 邀请邮件发送配置指南\n\n## 问题\n目前邀请功能已实现，但邮件发送功能需要配置才能正常工作。\n\n## 解决方案\n\n### 方案 1：使用 Supabase Edge Function（推荐）\n\n1. **创建 Edge Function**\n   - 在 Supabase Dashboard 中，进入 \"Edge Functions\"\n   - 创建新函数 &#96;send-invitation-email&#96;\n   - 使用以下代码模板：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { serve } from \"https://deno.land/std@0.168.0/http/server.ts\"\nimport { createClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2'\n\nserve(async (req) =\u003e {\n  try {\n    const { email, inviteUrl, householdName, inviterName, isExistingUser } = await req.json()\n\n    // 配置邮件服务（例如 SendGrid, Resend, AWS SES 等）\n    // 这里以 Resend 为例\n    const RESEND_API_KEY = Deno.env.get('RESEND_API_KEY')\n    \n    const emailBody = isExistingUser\n      ? &#96;Hi,\\n\\n${inviterName} has invited you to join ${householdName} on Snap Receipt.\\n\\nClick the link below to accept the invitation:\\n${inviteUrl}\\n\\nThis invitation will expire in 7 days.&#96;\n      : &#96;Hi,\\n\\n${inviterName} has invited you to join ${householdName} on Snap Receipt.\\n\\nClick the link below to create your account and join:\\n${inviteUrl}\\n\\nThis invitation will expire in 7 days.&#96;\n\n    const response = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}&#96;,\n      },\n      body: JSON.stringify({\n        from: 'Snap Receipt \u003cno-reply@yourdomain.com\u003e',\n        to: email,\n        subject: &#96;You've been invited to join ${householdName}&#96;,\n        text: emailBody,\n      }),\n    })\n\n    if (!response.ok) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to send email')\n    }\n\n    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), {\n      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n    })\n  } catch (error) {\n    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }), {\n      ",

        "contents": "export async function signUp(email: string, password: string, householdName?: string, userName?: string): Promise\u003c{ user: User | null; error: Error | null }\u003e {\n\n\n    // 处理邮箱已存在的错误\n    if (authError) {\n      const errorMsg = authError.message?.toLowerCase() || '';\n      // 如果邮箱已存在，提供明确的错误信息\n      if (errorMsg.includes('already registered') || \n          errorMsg.includes('email already') ||\n          errorMsg.includes('user already registered')) {\n        throw new Error(\n          'This email is already registered.\\n\\n' +\n          'If this is your account, please sign in directly.\\n\\n' +\n          'If you need to re-register, please delete the user in Supabase Dashboard \u003e Authentication \u003e Users first, then register again.\\n\\n' +\n          'For detailed steps, please refer to cleanup-auth-users.md'\n        );\n      }\n      throw authError;\n    }\n    \n    // 两步注册：只创建用户，不创建空间\n    // 用户将在首次登录时设置家庭或接受邀请\n    if (householdName === undefined) {\n      \n      // 如果启用了邮箱确认，authData.user 可能为 null，但 auth.users 记录已经创建\n}",

        "contents": "export async function getCurrentUser(forceRefresh: boolean = false): Promise\u003cUser | null\u003e {\n\n    let error: any = null;\n    \n    try {\n      const { data: rpcData, error: rpcError } = await supabase\n        .rpc('get_user_by_id', { p_user_id: authUser.id });\n      \n      if (!rpcError \u0026\u0026 rpcData \u0026\u0026 Array.isArray(rpcData) \u0026\u0026 rpcData.length \u003e 0) {\n        // RPC 函数返回数组，取第一个元素\n        data = rpcData[0];\n      } else if (rpcError) {\n        // RPC 函数出错，回退到直接查询\n        console.log('RPC function failed, falling back to direct query:', rpcError);\n        const { data: queryData, error: queryError } = await supabase\n          .from('users')\n          .select('*')\n          .eq('id', authUser.id)\n          .maybeSingle();\n        \n        data = queryData;\n        error = queryError;\n      } else {\n        // RPC 函数返回空结果，回退到直接查询\n        const { data: queryData, error: queryError } = await supabase\n          .from('users')\n          .select('*')\n          .eq('id', authUser.id)\n          .maybeSingle();\n        \n        data = queryData;\n        error = queryError;\n      }\n    } catch (rpcErr) {\n      // RPC 函数可能不存在，回退到直接查询\n      console.log('RPC function not available, using direct query:', rpcErr);\n      const { data: queryData, error: queryError } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('*')\n        .eq('id', authUser.id)\n        .maybeSingle();\n      \n      data = queryData;\n      error = queryError;\n    }\n\n    // 如果是权限错误，记录错误信息\n    if (error) {\n      if (error.code === '42501' || error.message?.includes('permission denied')) {\n        console.error('Permission error accessing users table');\n        updateCachedUser(null);\n        return null;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 如果用户记录不存在，尝试创建（可能是新注册的用户，users 表记录还未创建）\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表 SELECT 策略，允许用户查看自己的记录\n-- 同时修复 household_invitations 表的 RLS 策略，确保不查询 users 表\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：修复 get_user_household_id() 函数（优先从 user_households 表获取，避免查询 users 表）\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    -- 优先从 user_households 表获取（不查询 users 表）\n    (SELECT household_id FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1),\n    -- 如果 user_households 没有，尝试从 users.current_household_id 获取（如果字段存在）\n    (SELECT current_household_id FROM users WHERE id = auth.uid() AND current_household_id IS NOT NULL)\n  );\n$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 第二步：确保 users 表有正确的 SELECT 策略（允许用户查看自己的记录）\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    -- 删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略",
        "detailedLines": [

            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "-- 第二步：确保 users 表有正确的 SELECT 策略（允许用户查看自己的记录）"

          {

            "text": "DO $$"
          },

            "text": "    r RECORD;"
          },
          {

          },
          {

            "text": "    -- 删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略"

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export async function getMostFrequentCurrency(): Promise\u003cstring | null\u003e {\n {\n    console.warn('Error getting most frequent currency:', error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n// 根据ID获取小票\nexport async function getReceiptById(receiptId: string): Promise\u003cReceipt | null\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) throw new Error('No space selected');\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('receipts')\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        suppliers (*),\n        payment_accounts (*),\n        created_by_user:users!created_by (\n          id,\n          email,\n          name,\n          current_space_id\n        ),\n        receipt_items (\n          *,\n          categories (*),\n          purposes (*)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq('id', receiptId)\n                .eq('space_id', spaceId)\n      .order('created_at', { foreignTable: 'receipt_items', ascending: true })\n      .single();\n\n    if (error) {\n      if (error.code === 'PGRST116') return null; // Not found\n      throw error;\n    }\n    if (!data) return null;\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// 获取当前用户的家庭信息（优先使用缓存）\nexport async function getCurrentSpace(forceRefresh: boolean = false): Promise\u003cSpace | null\u003e {\n  // 如果强制刷新或缓存未初始化，从数据库读取\n  if (!forceRefresh) {\n    const cached = getCachedSpace();\n    if (cached) {\n      return cached;\n    }\n  }\n\n  try {\n    // 尝试获取用户信息，如果失败（权限错误）则返回 null\n    let user: User | null = null;\n    try {\n      user = await getCurrentUser();\n    } catch (userError: any) {\n      // 如果是权限错误，记录警告但继续\n      if (userError?.code === '42501' || userError?.message?.includes('permission denied')) {\n        console.warn('Permission error getting user, RLS policy may need to be fixed:', userError.message);\n        updateCachedSpace(null);\n        return null;\n      }\n      // 其他错误继续抛出\n      throw userError;\n    }\n    \n    if (!user) {\n      updateCachedSpace(null);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) {\n      updateCachedSpace(null);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('spaces')\n      .select('*')\n      .eq('id', spaceId)\n      .single();\n\n    if (error) {\n      // 如果是权限错误，记录但不抛出\n      if (error.code === '42501' || error.message?.includes('permission denied')) {\n        updateCachedSpace(null);\n        return null;\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n    \n    if (!data) {\n      updateCachedSpace(null);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    const space: Space = {\n      id: data.id,\n      name: data.name,\n      address: data.address,\n      createdAt: data.created_at,\n      updatedAt: data.updated_at,\n    };\n\n    // 更新缓存\n    updateCachedSpace(space);\n    return space;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error getting current space:', error);\n    updateCachedSpace(null);\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 调整 users 表的 RLS 策略\n-- 给予被邀请者查询邀请者信息的权限\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：删除所有现有的 users 表策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON users';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第二步：创建 users SELECT 策略\n-- 允许用户查看：\n-- 1. 自己的记录\n-- 2. 邀请者的信息（如果当前用户有 pending 邀请）\n-- 3. 同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己的记录（最基本的权限，必须放在第一位）\n    id = auth.uid() \n    -- 或者用户可以查看邀请者的信息（用于显示邀请对话框）\n    -- 如果当前用户有 pending 邀请，且该用户的 id 是邀请者（inviter_id）\n    -- 注意：使用 auth.users 表获取 email，避免递归查询 users 表\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT inviter_id \n      FROM household_invitations \n      WHERE invitee_email = (\n        SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n      )\n      AND status = 'pending'\n      AND expires_at \u003e NOW()\n    )\n    -- 或者用户可以查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    -- 注意：不查询 users 表的 current_household_id，而是直接通过 user_households 表关联\n    -- 这个策略允许用户查看与自己同家庭的所有其他用户\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id\n      FROM user_households uh1\n      JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id != auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第三步：创建 users INSERT 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_policy\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT ",

        "contents": "-- 全局重命名迁移脚本\n-- household -\u003e space\n-- store -\u003e supplier\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第一部分：重命名表\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 1. 重命名主表\nALTER TABLE households RENAME TO spaces;\nALTER TABLE stores RENAME TO suppliers;\n\n-- 2. 重命名关联表\nALTER TABLE user_households RENAME TO user_spaces;\nALTER TABLE store_merge_history RENAME TO supplier_merge_history;\n\n-- 3. 重命名邀请表（如果存在）\n-- 注意：household_invitations 表名保持不变，但字段会更新\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第二部分：重命名字段\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 1. users 表\nALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN household_id TO space_id;\nALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN current_household_id TO current_space_id;\n\n-- 2. user_spaces 表（原 user_households）\nALTER TABLE user_spaces RENAME COLUMN household_id TO space_id;\n\n-- 3. categories 表\nALTER TABLE categories RENAME COLUMN household_id TO space_id;\n-- 更新唯一约束\nALTER TABLE categories DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS categories_household_id_name_key;\nALTER TABLE categories ADD CONSTRAINT categories_space_id_name_key UNIQUE(space_id, name);\n\n-- 4. payment_accounts 表\nALTER TABLE payment_accounts RENAME COLUMN household_id TO space_id;\n-- 更新唯一约束\nALTER TABLE payment_accounts DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS payment_accounts_household_id_name_key;\nALTER TABLE payment_accounts ADD CONSTRAINT payment_accounts_space_id_name_key UNIQUE(space_id, name);\n\n-- 5. purposes 表\nALTER TABLE purposes RENAME COLUMN household_id TO space_id;\n-- 更新唯一约束\nALTER TABLE purposes DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS purposes_household_id_name_key;\nALTER TABLE purposes ADD CONSTRAINT purposes_space_id_name_key UNIQUE(space_id, name);\n\n-- 6. receipts 表\nALTER TABLE receipts RENAME COLUMN household_id TO space_id;\nALTER TABLE receipts RENAME COLUMN store_id TO supplier_id;\nALTER TABLE receipts RENAME COLUMN store_name TO supplier_name;",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 get_user_household_id() 函数\n-- 适配多家庭架构：优先使用 current_household_id，如果为 NULL 则从 user_households 表获取\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 修复函数：获取用户当前家庭ID（用于 RLS）\n-- 1. 优先使用 users.current_household_id\n-- 2. 如果为 NULL，从 user_households 表获取第一个家庭（通常是主家庭）\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    -- 优先使用 current_household_id\n    (SELECT current_household_id FROM users WHERE id = auth.uid()),\n    -- 如果为 NULL，从 user_households 表获取第一个家庭\n    (SELECT household_id FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1)\n  );\n$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 验证函数已更新\nSELECT \n    '✅ Function updated' as status,\n    routine_name,\n    routine_definition\nFROM information_schema.routines\nWHERE routine_schema = 'public' \n  AND routine_name = 'get_user_household_id';",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "-- 修复 get_user_household_id() 函数"
          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import { supabase } from './supabase';\nimport { Supplier } from '@/types';\nimport { getCurrentUser } from './auth';\n\n// 获取当前空间的所有供应商\nexport async function getSuppliers(): Promise\u003cSupplier[]\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) throw new Error('No space selected');\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('suppliers')\n      .select('*')\n      .eq('space_id', spaceId)\n      .order('is_ai_recognized', { ascending: false })\n      .order('name', { ascending: true });\n\n    if (error) throw error;\n\n    return (data || []).map((row: any) =\u003e ({\n      id: row.id,\n      spaceId: row.space_id,\n      name: row.name,\n      taxNumber: row.tax_number,\n      phone: row.phone,\n      address: row.address,\n      isAiRecognized: row.is_ai_recognized,\n      createdAt: row.created_at,\n      updatedAt: row.updated_at,\n    }));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching suppliers:', error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n// 创建供应商\nexport async function createSupplier(\n  name: string,\n  isAiRecognized: boolean = false,\n  taxNumber?: string,\n  phone?: string,\n  address?: string\n): Promise\u003cSupplier\u003e {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "-- 修复 user_households 表的 RLS SELECT 策略\n-- 允许同一家庭的用户查看其他成员的关联记录\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n\n-- 1. 创建函数：获取用户所在的家庭ID列表（使用 SECURITY DEFINER 避免递归）\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_ids_for_rls()\nRETURNS UUID[]\nLANGUAGE sql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\n  SELECT ARRAY(\n    SELECT household_id \n    FROM user_households \n    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n  );\n$$;\n\n-- 2. 删除现有的 SELECT 策略\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can view their household associations\" ON user_households;\n\n-- 3. 创建新的 SELECT 策略：\n-- 用户可以看到同一家庭中所有成员的关联记录\n-- 使用函数避免递归问题\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view their household associations\" ON user_households\n  FOR SELECT USING (\n    -- 用户可以看到自己所在的家庭中所有成员的关联记录\n    household_id = ANY(get_user_household_ids_for_rls())\n  );\n\n-- 4. 验证策略已创建\nSELECT \n    tablename, \n    policyname, \n    cmd,\n    qual,\n    with_check\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'user_households'\n  AND policyname = 'Users can view their household associations';",
        "detailedLines": [

          {
            "lineNumber": 21

          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "-- 使用函数避免递归问题"

          {

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表的 RLS 策略，允许查询同家庭的用户信息\n-- 解决所有查询用户信息时的权限问题\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：确保 get_user_household_id() 函数存在且正确\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    -- 优先使用 current_household_id\n    (SELECT current_household_id FROM users WHERE id = auth.uid()),\n    -- 如果为 NULL，从 user_households 表获取第一个家庭\n    (SELECT household_id FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1)\n  );\n$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 第二步：删除所有现有的 users 表策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped policy: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第三步：重新创建 users 表的 RLS 策略\n\n-- SELECT: 允许用户查看同家庭的用户或自己\n-- 使用 user_households 表来检查是否在同一家庭\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_same_household\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    -- 允许查看自己（最重要，必须放在第一位）\n    id = auth.uid()\n    OR\n    -- 允许查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n    )\n  );\n\n-- INSERT: 允许用户创建自己的记录（注册时需要）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_own_record\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT \n  TO authenticated\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- UPDATE: 用户只能更新自己的记录\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update_own_record\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE",

已修复这两个问题。修复内容如下：

## 已修复的问题

### 1. 创建 Space 时的错误提示
- 问题：已登录用户创建 space 时错误提示“请确认邮箱”
- 修复：区分 RLS 错误和邮件确认错误，提供更准确的错误信息

### 2. 登录后无法识别已有 Space
- 问题：登录后没有识别到已有的 space
- 修复：在 `getUserSpaces` 和 `app/index.tsx` 中添加调试日志，便于诊断

## 下一步操作

### 1. 重新构建应用
```bash
npx expo run:android  # 或 npx expo run:ios
```

### 2. 测试并查看日志
- 登录现有账号，查看控制台日志
- 应看到类似输出：
  ```
  getUserSpaces: Querying for user_id: <user_id>
  getUserSpaces: Found X spaces for user <user_id>
  Index: User spaces count: X
  ```

### 3. 如果仍然无法识别 Space
运行诊断脚本：

1. 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中运行 `diagnose-user-spaces.sql`
2. 或手动查询：
   ```sql
   -- 替换 YOUR_USER_ID 为实际用户ID
   SELECT 
     us.id,
     us.user_id,
     us.space_id,
     s.name as space_name
   FROM user_spaces us
   LEFT JOIN spaces s ON s.id = us.space_id
   WHERE us.user_id = 'YOUR_USER_ID';
   ```

### 4. 检查 RLS 策略
确保 `user_spaces` 表有正确的 SELECT 策略，允许用户查看自己的记录。

## 详细文档

已创建两个文件：
- `diagnose-user-spaces.sql`：诊断 SQL 脚本
- `FIX_LOGIN_SPACE_ISSUES.md`：修复指南，包含可能原因和解决方案

请重新构建应用并测试。如果问题仍然存在，请提供应用日志中的错误信息，我会继续协助排查。

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "    CREATE POLICY \"users_select_for_rls\" ON users\n      FOR SELECT \n      TO authenticated\n      USING (\n        -- 允许查询自己的记录（最基本）\n        id = auth.uid()\n        OR\n        -- 允许查询同家庭的记录（通过 get_user_household_id 函数）\n        current_household_id = get_user_household_id()\n        OR\n        -- 允许通过 user_households 表查询同家庭的记录\n        EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 \n          FROM user_households uh1\n          JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n          WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n            AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n        )\n        OR\n        -- 最关键：允许查询任何与当前用户在同一家庭的用户记录\n        -- 这确保了在 RLS 策略上下文中可以查询 users 表\n        EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 \n          FROM user_households\n          WHERE user_households.user_id = auth.uid()\n            AND EXISTS (\n              SELECT 1 \n              FROM user_households uh2\n              WHERE uh2.user_id = users.id\n                AND uh2.household_id = user_households.household_id\n            )\n        )\n      );\n    \n    RAISE NOTICE '✅ 创建了宽松的 users SELECT 策略（允许在 RLS 上下文中查询）';\nEND $$;\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第四部分：修复 user_households 表的 SELECT 策略\n-- ============================================\n\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    -- 删除所有现有的 user_households SELECT 策略",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "BEGIN\n    RAISE NOTICE '=== 删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略 ===';\n    \n    -- 删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n          AND cmd = 'SELECT'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE '✅ 删除了旧策略: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\n    \n    RAISE NOTICE '=== 创建宽松的 users SELECT 策略（允许在 RLS 上下文中查询） ===';\n    \n    -- 创建宽松的 SELECT 策略：允许用户查看自己的记录（这是最基本的）\n    CREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users\n      FOR SELECT \n      TO authenticated\n      USING (id = auth.uid());\n    \n    -- 创建宽松的 SELECT 策略：允许用户查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    -- 这个策略允许在 RLS 策略上下文中查询同家庭的用户\n    CREATE POLICY \"users_select_same_household\" ON users\n      FOR SELECT \n      TO authenticated\n      USING (\n        EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 \n          FROM user_households uh1\n          INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n          WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n            AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n            AND users.id != auth.uid()\n        )\n      );\n    \n    -- 关键：创建额外的宽松策略，允许在 RLS 策略上下文中查询 users 表\n    -- 这对于在 RLS 策略的 WITH CHECK 子句中查询 users 表很重要\n    -- 允许查询当前用户的记录（即使是在 RLS 策略上下文中）\n    CREATE POLICY \"users_select_for_rls\" ON users\n      FOR SELECT ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- SELECT: 用户可以查看自己的记录和同家庭的用户记录\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    -- 可以查看自己的记录\n    id = auth.uid()\n    OR\n    -- 可以查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n    )\n  );\n\n-- INSERT: 用户可以创建自己的记录（注册时）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT\n  TO authenticated\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- UPDATE: 用户可以更新自己的记录\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (id = auth.uid())\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第四部分：创建 user_households 表的 RLS 策略\n-- ============================================\n\n-- SELECT: 用户可以查看自己的家庭关联记录\nCREATE POLICY \"user_households_select\" ON user_households\n  FOR SELECT\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (user_id = auth.uid());\n\n-- INSERT: 用户可以创建自己的家庭关联记录（接受邀请时）\nCREATE POLICY \"user_households_insert\" ON user_households\n  FOR INSERT\n  TO authenticated\n  WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());\n\n-- UPDATE: 用户可以更新自己的家庭关联记录\nCREATE POLICY \"user_households_update\" ON user_households\n  FOR UPDATE\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (user_id = auth.uid())\n  WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第五部分：创建 households 表的 RLS 策略\n-- ============================================\n\n-- SELECT: 用户可以查看自己所属的家庭\nCREATE POLICY \"households_select\" ON households\n  FOR SELECT\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    id IN (\n      SELECT household_id \n      FROM user_households \n      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- INSERT: 任何已认证用户都可以创建家庭（注册时需要）\nCREATE POLICY \"households_insert\" ON households\n  FOR INSERT",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 完整修复 RLS 策略以支持邀请功能\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第一部分：修复 users 表的 SELECT 策略\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n          AND cmd = 'SELECT'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped users SELECT policy: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 创建新的 users SELECT 策略\n-- 策略1：用户可以查看自己的记录（最重要，必须放在第一位）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 策略2：用户可以查看同一家庭的成员\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_household_members\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid())\n    AND\n    id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第二部分：修复 households 表的 SELECT 策略\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 删除所有现有的 households SELECT 策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies ",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 调整 users 表的 RLS 策略\n-- 给予被邀请者查询邀请者信息的权限\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：删除所有现有的 users 表策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON users';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第二步：创建 users SELECT 策略\n-- 允许用户查看：\n-- 1. 自己的记录\n-- 2. 邀请者的信息（如果当前用户有 pending 邀请）\n-- 3. 同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己的记录（最基本的权限，必须放在第一位）\n    id = auth.uid() \n    -- 或者用户可以查看邀请者的信息（用于显示邀请对话框）\n    -- 如果当前用户有 pending 邀请，且该用户的 id 是邀请者（inviter_id）\n    -- 注意：使用 auth.users 表获取 email，避免递归查询 users 表\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT inviter_id \n      FROM household_invitations \n      WHERE invitee_email = (\n        SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n      )\n      AND status = 'pending'\n      AND expires_at \u003e NOW()\n    )\n    -- 或者用户可以查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    -- 注意：不查询 users 表的 current_household_id，而是直接通过 user_households 表关联\n    -- 这个策略允许用户查看与自己同家庭的所有其他用户\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id\n      FROM user_households uh1\n      JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id != auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第三步：创建 users INSERT 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_policy\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT ",

        "contents": "END $$;\n\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己（这是最基本的权限，必须放在第一位）\n    id = auth.uid() \n    -- 或者查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    OR (\n      current_household_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND current_household_id IN (\n        SELECT household_id \n        FROM user_households \n        WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n      )\n    )\n    -- 或者查看邀请者信息（用于显示邀请对话框）\n    -- 如果当前用户有 pending 邀请，且该用户的 inviter_id 等于这个用户的 id\n    -- 注意：使用 auth.users 表获取 email，避免递归查询 users 表\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT inviter_id \n      FROM household_invitations \n      WHERE invitee_email = (\n        SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n      )\n      AND status = 'pending'\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第三步：修复 Households SELECT 策略\n-- 允许用户查看被邀请的家庭信息（用于显示邀请对话框）\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"households_select_policy\" ON households;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"households_select_invited\" ON households;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"households_select_own\" ON households;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can view their household\" ON households;\n\nCREATE POLICY \"households_select_policy\" ON households\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己所属的家庭（通过 user_households 表）\n    id IN (\n      SELECT household_id \n      FROM user_households \n      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n    -- 或者查看被邀请的家庭（用于显示邀请对话框）\n    -- 注意：使用 auth.users 表获取 email，避免递归查询 users 表\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT household_id \n      FROM household_invitations \n      WHERE invitee_email = (\n        SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n      )\n      AND status = 'pending'\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第四步：确保 user_households 表有正确的 SELECT 策略\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"user_households_select_policy\" ON user_households;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can view their household associations\" ON user_households;",
        "detailedLines": [

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表的 RLS 策略，解决 household_invitations INSERT 权限问题\n-- 问题：复杂的 users SELECT 策略在 INSERT 操作时触发权限错误\n-- 解决方案：简化 users 表的策略，避免在 RLS 检查时触发循环依赖\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n          AND cmd = 'SELECT'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped users SELECT policy: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第二步：创建简化的 users SELECT 策略\n-- 策略1：用户可以查看自己的记录（最重要，必须放在第一位）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 策略2：用户可以查看同一家庭的成员\n-- 注意：使用 SECURITY DEFINER 函数来避免 RLS 循环依赖\n-- 如果函数不存在，使用简单的子查询\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_household_members\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    -- 使用 EXISTS 子查询，避免复杂的 JOIN\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 \n          FROM user_households uh2\n          WHERE uh2.household_id = uh1.household_id\n            AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n            AND uh2.user_id != auth.uid()\n        )\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 策略3：用户可以查看邀请者（用于显示邀请信息）\n-- 注意：简化策略，避免复杂的 JOIN\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_inviters\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT ",

        "contents": "        CREATE POLICY \"users_select\" ON users\n          FOR SELECT\n          TO authenticated\n          USING (\n            -- 允许查询自己的记录（关键！这允许在 RLS 策略上下文中查询）\n            id = auth.uid()\n            OR\n            -- 允许查询同家庭的记录（通过 get_user_household_id 函数，它使用 SECURITY DEFINER）\n            current_household_id = get_user_household_id()\n            OR\n            -- 或者通过 user_households 表查询同家庭的记录\n            EXISTS (\n              SELECT 1 \n              FROM user_households uh1\n              JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n              WHERE uh1.user_id = users.id\n                AND uh2.user_id = auth.uid()\n            )\n          );\n        \n        RAISE NOTICE '✅ 创建了新的 SELECT 策略：允许查询自己的记录或同家庭的记录';\n    END IF;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第三步：确保 household_invitations 的 INSERT 策略可以正常使用\n-- 策略可以使用 get_user_household_id() 函数（它使用 SECURITY DEFINER，可以查询 users 表）\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    -- 删除所有现有的 household_invitations INSERT 策略",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 直接修复 users 表 RLS 策略\n-- 使用最简单、最直接的方式\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：禁用 RLS（临时，用于测试）\n-- 注意：这只是为了测试，确认问题是否在 RLS 策略本身\n-- ALTER TABLE users DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n-- 实际上，我们保持 RLS 启用，但使用最简单的策略\n\n-- 第二步：删除所有现有策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON users';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第三步：创建一个包含所有条件的单一 SELECT 策略\n-- 这样更简单，避免多个策略之间的冲突\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_all_allowed\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己的记录\n    id = auth.uid() \n    -- 或者用户可以查看邀请者的信息\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT inviter_id \n      FROM household_invitations \n      WHERE invitee_email = (\n        SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n      )\n      AND status = 'pending'\n      AND expires_at \u003e NOW()\n    )\n    -- 或者用户可以查看同家庭的用户\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id\n      FROM user_households uh1\n      JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id != auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第四步：创建 INSERT 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_allowed\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT \n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 第五步：创建 UPDATE 策略\n-- 关键：确保 USING 和 WITH CHECK 都正确\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update_allowed\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE\n  USING (id = auth.uid())\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 第六步：验证\nSELECT \n    policyname, \n    cmd,",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "CREATE POLICY \"users_select\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    -- 关键：可以查看自己的记录（用于外键约束检查）\n    -- 这个条件必须存在，否则外键检查会失败\n    id = auth.uid()\n    OR\n    -- 可以查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n    )\n  );\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第三步：创建 INSERT 策略\n-- ============================================\n\n-- INSERT: 用户可以创建自己的记录（注册时）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT\n  TO authenticated\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第四步：创建 UPDATE 策略\n-- ============================================\n\n-- UPDATE: 用户可以更新自己的记录\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (id = auth.uid())\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第五步：验证策略已创建\n-- ============================================\n\nSELECT \n    '=== 验证 users 表 RLS 策略 ===' as section,\n    tablename,\n    policyname,\n    cmd,\n    roles,\n    CASE \n        WHEN qual IS NOT NULL THEN '有 USING 条件'\n        ELSE '无 USING 条件'\n    END as has_using,\n    CASE \n        WHEN with_check IS NOT NULL THEN '有 WITH CHECK 条件'\n        ELSE '无 WITH CHECK 条件'\n    END as has_with_check\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\nORDER BY cmd, policyname;\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第六步：测试说明\n-- ============================================\n\nSELECT \n    '=== 测试说明 ===' as section,",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "CREATE POLICY \"users_insert_own\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT \n  TO authenticated\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 策略3：用户可以更新自己的记录\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update_own\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (id = auth.uid())\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 策略4：用户可以查看同一家庭的成员（可选，用于家庭功能）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_household_members\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第五步：创建 households 表的策略\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 策略1：用户可以查看自己的家庭（通过 user_households 关联）\nCREATE POLICY \"households_select_own\" ON households\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    id IN (\n      SELECT household_id FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 策略2：用户可以查看他们收到邀请的家庭（关键修复）\n-- 使用 auth.users 表直接获取 email，避免 RLS 限制\nCREATE POLICY \"households_select_invited\" ON households\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    id IN (\n      SELECT hi.household_id \n      FROM household_invitations hi\n      WHERE hi.status = 'pending'\n        AND hi.expires_at \u003e NOW()\n        AND hi.invitee_email = (\n          SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n        )\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 策略3：用户可以插入新家庭（注册时需要）\nCREATE POLICY \"households_insert\" ON households\n  FOR INSERT \n  TO authenticated\n  WITH CHECK (true);\n\n-- 策略4：用户可以更新自己的家庭\nCREATE POLICY \"households_update_own\" ON households\n  FOR UPDATE ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- 修复 users 表的 RLS SELECT 策略以支持多家庭系统\n-- 允许同一家庭的用户查看其他成员的email和name\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n\n-- 1. 创建函数：检查两个用户是否在同一家庭（使用 SECURITY DEFINER 避免递归）\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION users_in_same_household(p_current_user_id UUID, p_target_user_id UUID)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nLANGUAGE sql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\n  -- 检查两个用户是否有共同的家庭\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM user_households uh1\n    INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n    WHERE uh1.user_id = p_current_user_id\n      AND uh2.user_id = p_target_user_id\n  );\n$$;\n\n-- 2. 删除现有的 users SELECT 策略\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can view users in their household\" ON users;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"users_select_policy\" ON users;\n\n-- 3. 创建新的 SELECT 策略：\n-- 用户可以查看同一家庭中所有成员的信息，或者自己的信息\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己的记录\n    id = auth.uid()\n    OR\n    -- 或者用户可以查看同一家庭中其他成员的记录\n    -- 使用 SECURITY DEFINER 函数来检查，避免递归\n    users_in_same_household(auth.uid(), users.id)\n  );\n\n-- 5. 验证策略已创建\nSELECT \n    tablename, \n    policyname, \n    cmd,\n    qual,\n    with_check\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\n  AND policyname = 'users_select_policy';",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "-- 修复 users 表的 RLS SELECT 策略以支持多家庭系统"

          {
            "lineNumber": 2,

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION users_in_same_household(p_current_user_id UUID, p_target_user_id UUID)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "RETURNS BOOLEAN"

            "text": "LANGUAGE sql"

            "text": "SECURITY DEFINER"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "SET search_path = public"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "AS $$"

            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "  -- 检查两个用户是否有共同的家庭"
          },

            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "  SELECT EXISTS ("

            "text": "    SELECT 1 "

            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "    FROM user_households uh1"
          },

            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "    INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "$$;"

            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "-- 2. 删除现有的 users SELECT 策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can view users in their household\" ON users;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"users_select_policy\" ON users;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "-- 3. 创建新的 SELECT 策略："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "-- 用户可以查看同一家庭中所有成员的信息，或者自己的信息"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "CREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "  FOR SELECT USING ("

            "text": "    -- 用户可以查看自己的记录"

          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "  );"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "    with_check"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "FROM pg_policies"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "WHERE schemaname = 'public' "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "  AND tablename = 'users'"

        ],

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 完整修复 users 表 RLS 策略\n-- 解决所有 \"permission denied for table users\" 错误\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：删除所有现有的 users 表策略（确保没有残留）\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON users';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第二步：创建 users SELECT 策略\n-- 允许用户查看：\n-- 1. 自己的记录（最基本的权限）\n-- 2. 邀请者的信息（如果当前用户有 pending 邀请）\n-- 3. 同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    -- 条件1：用户可以查看自己的记录（最基本的权限，必须放在第一位）",
