      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# 构建完成后，通过 TestFlight 或直接安装\n# 然后运行开发服务器\nnpx expo start --dev-client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 在设备上测试\n\n1. **确保设备和电脑在同一网络**（或使用 USB 连接）\n\n2. **启动开发服务器**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --dev-client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **在设备上打开应用**，它会自动连接到开发服务器\n\n4. **扫描二维码**（如果需要）：\n   - 开发服务器会显示二维码\n   - 在开发客户端中扫描即可连接\n\n## 方法 3：使用 Expo Go（仅测试非原生功能）\n\n如果只想测试非原生功能（如图片选择、UI 等），可以在 Expo Go 中测试：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --go\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**注意**：原生扫描功能（&#96;DocumentScanner.scanDocument()&#96;）在 Expo Go 中不可用，会显示提示信息，但可以从相册选择图片。\n\n## 常见问题\n\n### 1. Android 构建失败：找不到 SDK\n\n**解决方案**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 设置 Android SDK 路径\nexport ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk\nexport PATH=$PATH:$ANDROID_HOME/tools\nexport PATH=$PATH:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n或在 &#96;~/.zshrc&#96; 或 &#96;~/.bashrc&#96; 中添加上述配置。\n\n### 2. iOS 构建失败：CocoaPods 错误\n\n**解决方案**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd ios\npod deintegrate\npod install\ncd ..\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 开发服务器连接失败\n\n**解决方案**：\n- 确保设备和电脑在同一网络\n- 检查防火墙设置\n- 尝试使用 &#96;--tunnel&#96; 模式：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --dev-client --tunnel\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. 原生模块未找到\n\n**解决方案**：\n- 确保运行了 &#96;npx expo prebuild&#96;\n- 重新构建应用：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Android\nnpx expo run:android\n\n# iOS\nnpx expo run:ios\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 开发工作流\n\n### 日常开发流程\n\n1. **启动开发服务器**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --dev-client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **修改代码**后，应用会自动热重载\n\n3. **添加新的原生依赖**时：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. 安装 npm 包\nnpm install \u003cpackage-name\u003e\n\n# 2. 重新预构建\nnpx expo prebuild --clean\n\n# 3. 重新运行\nnpx expo run:android  # 或 ios\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 清理构建",

        "contents": "export default function HomeScreen() {\nconst processCapturedImage = async \n\n\n      setIsProcessing(false);\n      setCapturedReceiptId(receiptId);\n\n      // 4. Background processing with Gemini\n      processReceiptInBackground(imageUrl, receiptId, processedImageUri)\n        .then(() =\u003e console.log('Background processing started'))\n        .catch(err =\u003e console.error('Background processing failed:', err));\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      setIsProcessing(false);\n      console.error('Processing error:', error);\n      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to process receipt.');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCameraPress = () =\u003e {\n    // Show action sheet to choose between scan and pick from gallery\n    Alert.alert(\n      'Scan Receipt',\n      'Choose an option',\n      [\n        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },\n        { text: 'Scan Document', onPress: scanDocument },\n        { text: 'Pick from Gallery', onPress: pickImage }\n      ]\n    );\n  };\n\n  if (isLoggedIn === null) {\n    return (\n      \u003cView style={styles.container}\u003e\n        \u003cStatusBar style=\"dark\" /\u003e\n        \u003cView style={styles.content}\u003e\n          \u003cActivityIndicator size=\"large\" color=\"#6C5CE7\" /\u003e\n          \u003cText style={styles.title}\u003eLoading...\u003c/Text\u003e\n        \u003c/View\u003e\n      \u003c/View\u003e\n    );\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# 本地测试指南（使用原生模块）\n\n由于项目使用了原生模块（&#96;react-native-document-scanner-plugin&#96;），无法在 Expo Go 中测试，需要使用开发构建。\n\n## 方法 1：本地开发构建（推荐，快速测试）\n\n### 前置要求\n\n1. **Android 开发环境**：\n   - 安装 Android Studio\n   - 配置 Android SDK\n   - 设置 &#96;ANDROID_HOME&#96; 环境变量\n\n2. **iOS 开发环境**（仅 macOS）：\n   - 安装 Xcode\n   - 安装 CocoaPods：&#96;sudo gem install cocoapods&#96;\n\n### Android 本地构建步骤\n\n#### 1. 安装依赖\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install\n# 或\nyarn install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2. 预构建原生代码\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo prebuild --platform android\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n这会生成 &#96;android/&#96; 目录和原生代码。\n\n#### 3. 运行开发构建\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 方式 1：使用 Expo CLI（推荐）\nnpx expo run:android\n\n# 方式 2：直接使用 Gradle\ncd android\n./gradlew installDebug\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4. 启动开发服务器\n\n在另一个终端窗口：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --dev-client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n应用会自动连接到开发服务器，支持热重载。\n\n### iOS 本地构建步骤（仅 macOS）\n\n#### 1. 安装依赖\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2. 预构建原生代码\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo prebuild --platform ios\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3. 安装 CocoaPods 依赖\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd ios\npod install\ncd ..\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4. 运行开发构建\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo run:ios\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 5. 启动开发服务器\n\n在另一个终端窗口：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --dev-client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 方法 2：EAS 开发构建（推荐用于团队协作）\n\n### 前置要求\n\n1. 安装 EAS CLI：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g eas-cli\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. 登录 EAS：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\neas login\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 构建开发版本\n\n#### Android\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 构建开发版本 APK\neas build --platform android --profile development\n\n# 构建完成后，下载并安装到设备\n# 然后运行开发服务器\nnpx expo start --dev-client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### iOS\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 构建开发版本（需要 Apple Developer 账号）\neas build --platform ios --profile development\n\n# 构建完成后，通过 TestFlight 或直接安装\n# 然后运行开发服务器\nnpx expo start --dev-client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Expo Go 连接问题详细排查\n\n## 问题：Apple 手机扫码显示\"未找到可用数据\"\n\n## 逐步排查步骤\n\n### 步骤 1：确认开发服务器正在运行\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /Users/macbook/receipt-tracker\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n确保看到：\n- ✅ QR Code 显示\n- ✅ \"Metro waiting on...\" 消息\n- ✅ 没有错误信息\n\n### 步骤 2：尝试不同的连接模式\n\n#### 方法 A：Tunnel 模式（最可靠）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --tunnel\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**优点**：\n- 不依赖本地网络\n- 可以跨网络连接\n- 最稳定\n\n**缺点**：\n- 可能较慢\n- 需要网络连接\n\n#### 方法 B：LAN 模式（需要同一 WiFi）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --lan\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**检查事项**：\n1. 确保手机和电脑在同一 WiFi\n2. 检查防火墙设置\n3. 确保 IP 地址正确\n\n#### 方法 C：Localhost 模式（仅限模拟器）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --localhost\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 步骤 3：检查网络连接\n\n#### 检查电脑 IP 地址\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# macOS\nifconfig | grep \"inet \" | grep -v 127.0.0.1\n\n# 应该看到类似：inet 192.168.x.x 或 10.x.x.x\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 测试网络连接\n\n在手机浏览器中访问：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nhttp://[电脑IP]:8081\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n如果无法访问，说明网络有问题。\n\n### 步骤 4：手动输入 URL\n\n如果二维码无法扫描：\n\n1. 打开 Expo Go 应用\n2. 点击 \"Enter URL manually\"\n3. 输入终端显示的 URL：\n   - Tunnel: &#96;exp://xxx.tunnel.exp.direct:80&#96;\n   - LAN: &#96;exp://192.168.x.x:8081&#96;\n\n### 步骤 5：清除缓存\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 清除 Expo 缓存\nnpx expo start --clear\n\n# 或者完全清除\nrm -rf .expo\nrm -rf node_modules/.cache\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 步骤 6：检查防火墙\n\n#### macOS 防火墙设置\n\n1. 打开\"系统设置\" \u003e \"网络\" \u003e \"防火墙\"\n2. 点击\"选项\"\n3. 确保允许 Node.js 和 Terminal 通过防火墙\n4. 或者临时关闭防火墙测试\n\n### 步骤 7：检查端口占用\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查 8081 端口是否被占用\nlsof -i :8081\n\n# 如果被占用，使用其他端口\nnpx expo start --port 8082\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 步骤 8：重启所有服务\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. 停止当前服务器（Ctrl+C）\n# 2. 完全重启",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Expo Go 连接问题修复指南\n\n## 问题：扫码显示\"未找到可用数据\"\n\n即使在同一 WiFi 下，Expo Go 扫码仍然无法连接。\n\n## ⚠️ Apple 设备特别说明\n\n对于 Apple 设备（iPhone/iPad），如果扫码无法连接，请按以下顺序尝试：\n\n1. **首先尝试 Tunnel 模式**（最可靠）\n2. **检查网络和防火墙设置**\n3. **手动输入 URL**\n4. **清除缓存并重启**\n\n## 解决方案\n\n### 方案 1：使用 Tunnel 模式（推荐）\n\nTunnel 模式通过 ngrok 创建隧道，可以绕过本地网络问题：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /Users/macbook/receipt-tracker\nnpx expo start --tunnel\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n或者：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --host tunnel\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 方案 2：使用 LAN 模式并检查网络\n\n1. **确保使用 LAN 模式**：\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npx expo start --lan\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **检查 IP 地址**：\n   - 确保电脑和手机在同一 WiFi 网络\n   - 检查电脑的本地 IP 地址（在终端运行 &#96;ifconfig&#96; 或 &#96;ipconfig&#96;）\n   - 确保 Expo 显示的 IP 地址正确\n\n3. **检查防火墙**：\n   - macOS：系统设置 \u003e 网络 \u003e 防火墙\n   - 确保允许 Node.js 和 Expo 通过防火墙\n\n### 方案 3：清除缓存并重启\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 清除缓存\nnpx expo start --clear\n\n# 或者完全重启\n# 1. 停止当前服务器（Ctrl+C）\n# 2. 清除缓存\nrm -rf .expo node_modules/.cache\n# 3. 重新启动\nnpx expo start --tunnel\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 方案 4：手动输入 URL\n\n如果二维码无法扫描，可以：\n\n1. 在 Expo Go 中点击\"Enter URL manually\"\n2. 输入终端显示的 URL（通常是 &#96;exp://xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx:8081&#96;）\n3. 或者使用 tunnel URL（&#96;exp://xxx.tunnel.exp.direct:80&#96;）\n\n## 常见问题排查\n\n### 1. 检查端口是否被占用\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# macOS/Linux\nlsof -i :8081\n\n# 如果端口被占用，可以指定其他端口\nnpx expo start --port 8082\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 检查网络连接\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查电脑的 IP 地址\nifconfig | grep \"inet \" | grep -v 127.0.0.1\n\n# 确保手机和电脑在同一网络\n# 在手机上打开浏览器，访问 http://[电脑IP]:8081\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 使用 localhost（仅限模拟器）",

            "text": "### 方案 4：手动输入 URL"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65,
            "text": "如果二维码无法扫描，可以："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "text": "1. 在 Expo Go 中点击\"Enter URL manually\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "2. 输入终端显示的 URL（通常是 &#96;exp://xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx:8081&#96;）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69,
            "text": "3. 或者使用 tunnel URL（&#96;exp://xxx.tunnel.exp.direct:80&#96;）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "## 常见问题排查"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73,
            "text": "### 1. 检查端口是否被占用"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76,
            "text": "# macOS/Linux"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77,
            "text": "lsof -i :8081"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79,
            "text": "# 如果端口被占用，可以指定其他端口"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80,
            "text": "npx expo start --port 8082"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83,
            "text": "### 2. 检查网络连接"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86,
            "text": "# 检查电脑的 IP 地址"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87,
            "text": "ifconfig | grep \"inet \" | grep -v 127.0.0.1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89,
            "text": "# 确保手机和电脑在同一网络"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90,
            "text": "# 在手机上打开浏览器，访问 http://[电脑IP]:8081"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93,
            "text": "### 3. 使用 localhost（仅限模拟器）"
          }
        ],

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 94
          },

        "contents": "import {\n  View,\n  Text,\n  StyleSheet,\n  TextInput,\n  TouchableOpacity,\n  Alert,\n  ActivityIndicator,\n  KeyboardAvoidingView,\n  Platform,\n  ScrollView,\n} from 'react-native';\nimport { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';\nimport { StatusBar } from 'expo-status-bar';\nimport { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';\nimport { signIn, getCurrentUser, getCurrentSpace } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { initializeAuthCache } from '@/lib/auth-cache';\n\nexport default function LoginScreen() {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const params = useLocalSearchParams\u003c{ inviteId?: string; email?: string }\u003e();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);\n  const passwordInputRef = useRef\u003cTextInput\u003e(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (params.email) {\n      setEmail(params.email);\n    }\n    \n    // 检查是否已有登录session，如果有则自动跳转\n    checkExistingSession();\n  }, [params]);\n\n  const checkExistingSession = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      const { isAuthenticated } = await import('@/lib/auth');\n      const authenticated = await isAuthenticated();\n      if (authenticated) {\n        // 已有session，跳转到首页（首页会处理后续逻辑）\n        router.replace('/');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 静默处理错误，不影响登录流程\n      console.log('Session check failed (non-blocking):', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleLogin = async () =\u003e\n;\n}",

console.log('Processing captured image:', imageUri);\n\n      const processedImageUri = await processImageForUpload(imageUri, {\n        autoCrop: true,\n        quality: 0.85\n      });\n 'Processing...',\n        totalAmount: 0,\n        date: today,\n        status: 'processing',\n        items: [],\n        imageUrl: imageUrl,\n      });\n      console.log('Receipt record created:', receiptId);\n\n      setIsProcessing(false);\n      \n      // Refresh receipts list\n      await loadReceipts();\n\n      // Background processing with Gemini\n       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# 图像增强功能说明\n\n## 功能概述\n\n应用已集成自动裁剪和图像质量调整功能，使用纯 JavaScript 实现，无需原生模块。这些功能在开发构建中可用，但不支持在 Expo Go 中测试。\n\n## 已实现的功能\n\n### 1. 自动裁剪\n\n- **功能**：自动检测文档边缘并裁剪，去除图片边缘的空白区域\n- **实现方式**：简化的边缘检测算法，自动去除图片边缘 5% 的边距\n- **适用场景**：拍摄小票时，自动去除背景，聚焦文档内容\n\n### 2. 图像质量优化\n\n- **压缩优化**：智能压缩，在保持质量的同时减小文件大小\n- **尺寸调整**：自动调整图片尺寸，最大不超过 2048x2048\n- **格式统一**：统一转换为 JPEG 格式，确保兼容性\n\n### 3. 亮度/对比度调整（间接实现）\n\n- **当前实现**：通过优化压缩质量来间接改善图像效果\n- **说明**：&#96;expo-image-manipulator&#96; 不直接支持亮度和对比度调整\n- **未来优化**：可以通过以下方式实现真正的亮度/对比度调整：\n  - 服务端处理（在 Gemini 识别前处理）\n  - 使用原生模块（需要开发构建）\n  - 使用 Canvas API（如果可用）\n\n## 使用方法\n\n### 在相机拍摄时\n\n功能已自动启用，拍摄照片时会自动应用：\n- ✅ 自动裁剪（去除 5% 边距）\n- ✅ 图像质量优化\n- ✅ 智能压缩\n\n### 从相册选择时\n\n功能也已自动启用，选择图片时会自动应用相同的处理。\n\n## 技术实现\n\n### 核心文件\n\n- &#96;lib/image-processor.ts&#96; - 图像处理核心逻辑\n  - &#96;processImageForUpload()&#96; - 主处理函数\n  - &#96;enhanceImage()&#96; - 图像增强函数\n  - &#96;detectEdges()&#96; - 边缘检测函数\n\n### 处理流程\n\n1. **边缘检测**：检测文档边缘（当前使用简化的中央裁剪算法）\n2. **自动裁剪**：根据检测结果裁剪图片\n3. **尺寸调整**：如果图片过大，按比例缩小\n4. **质量压缩**：智能压缩，确保文件大小合适\n5. **格式转换**：统一转换为 JPEG 格式\n\n## 配置选项",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# 图像增强功能说明"
          },

            "lineNumber": 4

          },

            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "### 2. 图像质量优化"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "- **压缩优化**：智能压缩，在保持质量的同时减小文件大小"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "- **尺寸调整**：自动调整图片尺寸，最大不超过 2048x2048"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "- **格式统一**：统一转换为 JPEG 格式，确保兼容性"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "### 3. 亮度/对比度调整（间接实现）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "- **当前实现**：通过优化压缩质量来间接改善图像效果"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "- **说明**：&#96;expo-image-manipulator&#96; 不直接支持亮度和对比度调整"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "- **未来优化**：可以通过以下方式实现真正的亮度/对比度调整："

            "text": "  - 服务端处理（在 Gemini 识别前处理）"

            "text": "  - 使用原生模块（需要开发构建）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "  - 使用 Canvas API（如果可用）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "## 使用方法"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "### 在相机拍摄时"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "功能已自动启用，拍摄照片时会自动应用："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "- ✅ 自动裁剪（去除 5% 边距）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "- ✅ 图像质量优化"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "- ✅ 智能压缩"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "### 从相册选择时"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "功能也已自动启用，选择图片时会自动应用相同的处理。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "## 技术实现"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "### 核心文件"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "- &#96;lib/image-processor.ts&#96; - 图像处理核心逻辑"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "  - &#96;processImageForUpload()&#96; - 主处理函数"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "  - &#96;enhanceImage()&#96; - 图像增强函数"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "  - &#96;detectEdges()&#96; - 边缘检测函数"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "### 处理流程"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "1. **边缘检测**：检测文档边缘（当前使用简化的中央裁剪算法）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "2. **自动裁剪**：根据检测结果裁剪图片"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "3. **尺寸调整**：如果图片过大，按比例缩小"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "4. **质量压缩**：智能压缩，确保文件大小合适"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58,
            "text": "5. **格式转换**：统一转换为 JPEG 格式"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "## 配置选项"
          }

        "contents": "5. **格式转换**：统一转换为 JPEG 格式\n\n## 配置选项\n\n可以在 &#96;app/camera.tsx&#96; 中调整处理参数：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nawait processImageForUpload(imageUri, {\n  autoCrop: true,        // 是否启用自动裁剪\n  brightness: 0.1,       // 亮度调整（当前通过压缩质量间接实现）\n  contrast: 0.15,        // 对比度调整（当前通过压缩质量间接实现）\n  quality: 0.85,         // 输出质量 (0-1)\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 注意事项\n\n1. **Expo Go 限制**：这些功能需要在开发构建中测试，不支持 Expo Go\n2. **性能考虑**：图像处理会消耗一定时间，已优化为异步处理，不阻塞 UI\n3. **边缘检测**：当前使用简化的算法，未来可以集成更高级的边缘检测\n4. **亮度/对比度**：当前通过压缩质量间接实现，真正的调整需要服务端或原生模块\n\n## 未来优化方向\n\n1. **更精确的边缘检测**：使用图像处理算法或 AI 模型\n2. **真正的亮度/对比度调整**：集成原生模块或服务端处理\n3. **透视矫正**：自动纠正拍摄角度导致的变形\n4. **智能锐化**：提高文字清晰度",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Apple 设备快速修复指南\n\n## 问题：iPhone/iPad 扫码显示\"未找到可用数据\"\n\n## 🚀 快速解决方案（按顺序尝试）\n\n### 1. 使用 Tunnel 模式（最可靠）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /Users/macbook/receipt-tracker\nnpx expo start --tunnel --clear\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**等待看到**：\n- ✅ QR Code\n- ✅ Tunnel URL（类似 &#96;exp://xxx.tunnel.exp.direct:80&#96;）\n\n### 2. 手动输入 URL（如果二维码无法扫描）\n\n1. 打开 Expo Go 应用\n2. 点击底部的 **\"Enter URL manually\"**\n3. 复制终端显示的完整 URL（包括 &#96;exp://&#96; 前缀）\n4. 粘贴并点击 \"Connect\"\n\n### 3. 完全重启 Expo Go\n\n1. **完全关闭应用**：\n   - iPhone X 及以后：从底部上滑，找到 Expo Go，上滑关闭\n   - iPhone 8 及以前：双击 Home 键，上滑关闭 Expo Go\n2. **重新打开 Expo Go**\n3. **再次尝试扫描或手动输入 URL**\n\n### 4. 检查网络设置\n\n#### 在 iPhone 上：\n\n1. 设置 \u003e WiFi\n2. 确保连接到与电脑相同的 WiFi\n3. 点击 WiFi 名称旁边的 ⓘ\n4. 确保 **\"私有地址\"** 已关闭（或尝试关闭再打开）\n5. 确保没有使用 VPN 或代理\n\n#### 在 Mac 上：\n\n1. 系统设置 \u003e 网络 \u003e 防火墙\n2. 点击\"选项\"\n3. 确保允许 Node.js 和 Terminal 通过\n4. 或临时关闭防火墙测试\n\n### 5. 清除所有缓存\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /Users/macbook/receipt-tracker\n\n# 停止当前服务器（如果正在运行）\n# 按 Ctrl+C\n\n# 清除所有缓存\nrm -rf .expo\nrm -rf node_modules/.cache\n\n# 重新启动（使用 tunnel 模式）\nnpx expo start --tunnel --clear\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 6. 检查 Expo Go 版本\n\n1. 打开 App Store\n2. 搜索 \"Expo Go\"\n3. 确保使用最新版本\n4. 如果不是最新，更新应用\n\n### 7. 使用 LAN 模式（如果 Tunnel 太慢）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx expo start --lan --clear\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n然后：\n1. 确保手机和电脑在同一 WiFi\n2. 在手机上打开浏览器，访问 &#96;http://[电脑IP]:8081&#96;\n3. 如果无法访问，说明网络有问题\n\n### 8. 检查终端输出\n\n启动后，终端应该显示：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n› Metro waiting on exp://192.168.x.x:8081\n› Scan the QR code above with Expo Go (Android) or the Camera app (iOS)",
        "detailedLines": [

            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "2. 点击\"选项\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "3. 确保允许 Node.js 和 Terminal 通过"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "4. 或临时关闭防火墙测试"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "### 5. 清除所有缓存"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "cd /Users/macbook/receipt-tracker"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "# 停止当前服务器（如果正在运行）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "# 按 Ctrl+C"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58,
            "text": "# 清除所有缓存"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59,
            "text": "rm -rf .expo"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "rm -rf node_modules/.cache"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "# 重新启动（使用 tunnel 模式）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "npx expo start --tunnel --clear"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66,
            "text": "### 6. 检查 Expo Go 版本"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "1. 打开 App Store"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69,
            "text": "2. 搜索 \"Expo Go\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "3. 确保使用最新版本"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "4. 如果不是最新，更新应用"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73,
            "text": "### 7. 使用 LAN 模式（如果 Tunnel 太慢）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76,
            "text": "npx expo start --lan --clear"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79,
            "text": "然后："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80,
            "text": "1. 确保手机和电脑在同一 WiFi"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81,
            "text": "2. 在手机上打开浏览器，访问 &#96;http://[电脑IP]:8081&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82,
            "text": "3. 如果无法访问，说明网络有问题"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84,
            "text": "### 8. 检查终端输出"

          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },

已修复 `DocumentScanner` 的导入问题。

## 已修复的问题

### 问题原因

`react-native-document-scanner-plugin` 是原生模块，在 Expo Go 中不可用。直接在文件顶部导入会导致应用无法启动。

### 修复内容

1. 移除了顶部的直接导入
2. 改为动态导入（只在需要时导入）
3. 添加了错误处理

### 修复的文件

- `app/index.tsx` - 已修复
- `app/receipts.tsx` - 已修复

## 现在需要做的

### 步骤 1：重新加载应用

在 Expo Go 中：
1. 摇动设备（或按 `Cmd+D` 在模拟器中）
2. 选择 "Reload"

或者停止并重新启动开发服务器：

```bash
# 停止当前服务器（Ctrl+C）
# 重新启动
npx expo start --go --tunnel --clear
```

### 步骤 2：测试功能

1. 打开应用 → 应该不再报错
2. 点击扫描按钮 → 会显示提示，可以选择从相册选择
3. 从相册选择图片 → 应该可以正常处理

## 现在的行为

### 在 Expo Go 中

- 点击扫描 → 显示提示："Development Build Required"
- 可以选择 "Pick from Gallery" 从相册选择图片
- 原生扫描功能不可用（这是正常的）

### 在开发构建中

- 点击扫描 → 打开原生扫描器
- 可以正常使用所有功能

## 如果仍然有问题

清除缓存：

```bash
# 停止服务器（Ctrl+C）

# 清除缓存
rm -rf .expo node_modules/.cache

# 重新启动
npx expo start --go --tunnel --clear
```

## 已完成的修复

1. 安装了 `@expo/ngrok@^4.1.0`（支持 Tunnel 模式）
2. 修复了 DocumentScanner 导入问题（Expo Go 兼容）
3. Watchman 警告可忽略（不影响功能）

## 现在可以重新启动

### 步骤 1：停止当前服务器

在运行 Expo 的终端按 `Ctrl+C`

### 步骤 2：重新启动（使用 Tunnel 模式）

```bash
npx expo start --go --tunnel --clear
```

或者使用 LAN 模式（如果手机和电脑在同一 WiFi）：

```bash
npx expo start --go --lan --clear
```

### 步骤 3：在 Expo Go 中连接

启动后应该看到：
- QR Code
- Tunnel URL（类似 `exp://xxx.tunnel.exp.direct:80`）

然后：
1. 打开 Expo Go 应用
2. 扫描二维码，或
3. 手动输入 URL（点击 "Enter URL manually"）

## 预期结果

应用应该能够：
- 正常启动（不再有 DocumentScanner 错误）
- 在 Expo Go 中运行
- 扫描功能会提示使用开发构建，但可以从相册选择图片

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export default function ReceiptsScreen() {\nconst groupReceiptsByPaymentAccount = (receipts: Receipt[]): SectionData[] =\u003e {\n\n    return Array.from(grouped.entries())\n      .map(([accountKey, data]) =\u003e {\n        const accountName = data[0].paymentAccount?.name || 'Not Set';\n        return {\n          title: accountName,\n          monthKey: accountKey,\n          data: data.sort((a, b) =\u003e parseLocalDate(b.date).getTime() - parseLocalDate(a.date).getTime()),\n        };\n      })\n      .sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n        // 未设置账户放在最后\n        if (a.title === 'Not Set') return 1;\n        if (b.title === 'Not Set') return -1;\n        return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);\n      });\n  }, []);\n\n  // 按提交人员分组小票\n  const groupReceiptsByCreatedBy = useCallback((receipts: Receipt[]): SectionData[] =\u003e {\n    const grouped = new Map\u003cstring, Receipt[]\u003e();\n    \n    receipts.forEach(receipt =\u003e {\n      const userName = receipt.createdByUser?.name || receipt.createdByUser?.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Unknown';\n      const userKey = &#96;user-${receipt.createdBy || 'unknown'}&#96;;\n      \n      if (!grouped.has(userKey)) {\n        grouped.set(userKey, []);\n      }\n      grouped.get(userKey)!.push(receipt);\n    });\n\n    // 转换为数组并按用户名排序\n    return Array.from(grouped.entries())\n      .map(([userKey, data]) =\u003e {\n        const userName = data[0].createdByUser?.name || data[0].createdByUser?.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Unknown';\n        return {\n          title: userName,\n          monthKey: userKey,\n          data: data.sort((a, b) =\u003e parseLocalDate(b.date).getTime() - parseLocalDate(a.date).getTime()),\n        };\n      })\n      .sort((a, b) =\u003e a.title.localeCompare(b.title));\n  }, []);\n\n  // 根据分组类型获取分组数据\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export async function getAllReceipts(): Promise\u003cReceipt[]\u003e {\nconst { data, error } = await \n('created_at', { ascending: false })\n      .order('created_at', { foreignTable: 'receipt_items', ascending: true });\n\n    if (error) throw error;\n\n    return (data || []).map((row: any) =\u003e ({\n      id: row.id,\n      spaceId: row.space_id,\n      supplierName: row.supplier_name,\n      storeName: row.supplier_name, // 向后兼容\n      supplierId: row.supplier_id,\n      supplier: row.suppliers ? {\n        id: row.suppliers.id,\n        spaceId: row.suppliers.space_id,\n        name: row.suppliers.name,\n        taxNumber: row.suppliers.tax_number,\n        phone: row.suppliers.phone,\n        address: row.suppliers.address,\n        isAiRecognized: row.suppliers.is_ai_recognized,\n        createdAt: row.suppliers.created_at,\n        updatedAt: row.suppliers.updated_at,\n      } : undefined,\n      totalAmount: row.total_amount,\n      currency: row.currency,\n      tax: row.tax,\n      date: normalizeDate(row.date),\n      paymentAccountId: row.payment_account_id,\n      paymentAccount: row.payment_accounts ? {\n        id: row.payment_accounts.id,\n        spaceId: row.payment_accounts.space_id,\n        name: row.payment_accounts.name,\n        isAiRecognized: row.payment_accounts.is_ai_recognized,\n        createdAt: row.payment_accounts.created_at,\n        updatedAt: row.payment_accounts.updated_at,\n      } : undefined,\n      status: row.status as ReceiptStatus,\n      imageUrl: row.image_url,\n      confidence: row.confidence,\n      processedBy: row.processed_by,\n      createdAt: row.created_at,\n      updatedAt: row.updated_at,\n      createdBy: row.created_by,\n      createdByUser: row.created_by_user ? {\n        id: row.created_by_user.id,\n        email: row.created_by_user.email,\n        name: row.created_by_user.name\n)\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- 添加 receipts 表的 created_by 字段\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n\n-- 添加 created_by 字段（引用 users 表的 id）\nALTER TABLE receipts \nADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;\n\n-- 为现有小票设置 created_by（如果有用户信息）\n-- 注意：这个更新只会为有用户信息的小票设置 created_by\n-- 对于没有用户信息的历史小票，created_by 将保持为 NULL\nUPDATE receipts r\nSET created_by = (\n  SELECT u.id \n  FROM users u \n  WHERE u.household_id = r.household_id \n  LIMIT 1\n)\nWHERE r.created_by IS NULL;\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_receipts_created_by ON receipts(created_by);\n\n-- 更新 RLS 策略以允许查询 created_by 关联的用户信息\n-- 注意：RLS 策略已经通过 household_id 控制访问，created_by 字段不需要额外的策略",
        "detailedLines": [

            "text": "-- 为现有小票设置 created_by（如果有用户信息）"

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export async function getReceiptById(receiptId: string): Promise\u003cReceipt | null\u003e {\nconst { data, error } = await \nsingle();\n\n    if (error) {\n      if (error.code === 'PGRST116') return null; // Not found\n      throw error;\n    }\n    if (!data) return null;\n\n    return {\n      id: data.id,\n      spaceId: data.space_id,\n      supplierName: data.supplier_name,\n      supplierId: data.supplier_id,\n      supplier: data.suppliers ? {\n        id: data.suppliers.id,\n        spaceId: data.suppliers.space_id,\n        name: data.suppliers.name,\n        taxNumber: data.suppliers.tax_number,\n        phone: data.suppliers.phone,\n        address: data.suppliers.address,\n        isAiRecognized: data.suppliers.is_ai_recognized,\n        createdAt: data.suppliers.created_at,\n        updatedAt: data.suppliers.updated_at,\n      } : undefined,\n      totalAmount: data.total_amount,\n      currency: data.currency,\n      tax: data.tax,\n      date: normalizeDate(data.date),\n      paymentAccountId: data.payment_account_id,\n      paymentAccount: data.payment_accounts ? {\n        id: data.payment_accounts.id,\n        spaceId: data.payment_accounts.space_id,\n        name: data.payment_accounts.name,\n        isAiRecognized: data.payment_accounts.is_ai_recognized,\n        createdAt: data.payment_accounts.created_at,\n        updatedAt: data.payment_accounts.updated_at,\n      } : undefined,\n      status: data.status as ReceiptStatus,\n      imageUrl: data.image_url,\n      confidence: data.confidence,\n      processedBy: data.processed_by,\n      createdAt: data.created_at,\n      updatedAt: data.updated_at,\n      createdBy: data.created_by,\n      createdByUser: data.created_by_user ? {\n        id: data.created_by_user.id,\n        email: data.created_by_user.email,\n        name: data.created_by_user.name\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateReceipt(receiptId: string, receipt: Partial\u003cReceipt\u003e): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n// 获取所有小票（当前家庭的）\nexport async function getAllReceipts(): Promise\u003cReceipt[]\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) throw new Error('No space selected');\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('receipts')\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        suppliers (*),\n        payment_accounts (*),\n        created_by_user:users!created_by (\n          id,\n          email,\n          name,\n          current_space_id\n        ),\n        receipt_items (\n          *,\n          categories (*),\n          purposes (*)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n                .eq('space_id', spaceId)\n      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })\n      .order('created_at', { foreignTable: 'receipt_items', ascending: true });\n\n    if (error) throw error;\n\n    return\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// 小票数据\nexport interface Receipt {\n  id?: string;\n  spaceId: string;\n  supplierName: string; // 供应商名称（保留 storeName 作为向后兼容）\n  storeName?: string; // 向后兼容字段，实际使用 supplierName\n  supplierId?: string; // 关联的供应商ID\n  supplier?: Supplier; // 关联的供应商对象\n  totalAmount: number;\n  date: string;\n  paymentAccountId?: string;\n  paymentAccount?: PaymentAccount; // 关联的支付账户对象\n  status: ReceiptStatus;\n  imageUrl?: string;\n  items: ReceiptItem[];\n  createdAt?: string;\n  updatedAt?: string;\n  processedBy?: string;\n  confidence?: number; // 整体识别置信度\n  currency?: string; // 币种，如：CNY、USD\n  tax?: number; // 税费\n  createdBy?: string; // 提交者用户ID\n  createdByUser?: User; // 提交者用户信息\n}\n\n// 用户数据\nexport interface User {\n  id: string;\n  email: string;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function getMostFrequentCurrency(): Promise\u003cstring | null\u003e {\n {\n    console.warn('Error getting most frequent currency:', error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n// 根据ID获取小票\nexport async function getReceiptById(receiptId: string): Promise\u003cReceipt | null\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) throw new Error('No space selected');\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('receipts')\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        suppliers (*),\n        payment_accounts (*),\n        created_by_user:users!created_by (\n          id,\n          email,\n          name,\n          current_space_id\n        ),\n        receipt_items (\n          *,\n          categories (*),\n          purposes (*)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq('id', receiptId)\n                .eq('space_id', spaceId)\n      .order('created_at', { foreignTable: 'receipt_items', ascending: true })\n      .single();\n\n    if (error) {\n      if (error.code === 'PGRST116') return null; // Not found\n      throw error;\n    }\n    if (!data) return null;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export default function ReceiptsScreen() {\nconst filteredReceipts = () =\u003e {\n {\n      filtered = filtered.filter(receipt =\u003e {\n        const accountId = receipt.paymentAccount?.id || 'none';\n        return selectedAccounts.has(accountId);\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 按提交人筛选\n    if (selectedCreators.size \u003e 0) {\n      filtered = filtered.filter(receipt =\u003e {\n        const creatorId = receipt.createdBy || 'unknown';\n        return selectedCreators.has(creatorId);\n      });\n    }\n\n    return filtered;\n  }, [receipts, selectedMonths, selectedAccounts, selectedCreators]);\n\n  // 获取所有可用的筛选选项\n  const filterOptions = useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    const months = new Set\u003cstring\u003e(); // 交易时间（月）\n    const recordDates = new Set\u003cstring\u003e(); // 记录时间（天）\n    const accounts = new Map\u003cstring, string\u003e(); // id -\u003e name\n    const creators = new Map\u003cstring, string\u003e(); // id -\u003e name\n\n    receipts.forEach(receipt =\u003e {\n      // 交易时间（月）\n      try {\n        const date = parseLocalDate(receipt.date);\n        const monthKey = &#96;${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}&#96;;\n        months.add(monthKey);\n      } catch {}\n\n      // 记录时间（天）\n      if (receipt.createdAt) {\n        try {\n          const createdAt = new Date(receipt.createdAt);\n          const year = createdAt.getFullYear();\n          const month = String(createdAt.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\n          const day = String(createdAt.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n          const dayKey = &#96;${year}-${month}-${day}&#96;;\n          recordDates.add(dayKey);\n        } catch {}\n      }\n\n      // 账户\n      if (receipt.paymentAccount) {\n        accounts.set(receipt.paymentAccount.id, receipt.paymentAccount.name);\n      } else {\n        accounts.set('none', 'Not Set');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "import {\n  View,\n  Text,\n  StyleSheet,\n  SectionList,\n  TouchableOpacity,\n  RefreshControl,\n  ActivityIndicator,\n  Alert,\n  TextInput,\n  Animated,\n  Modal,\n  ScrollView,\n} from 'react-native';\nimport { useRouter, useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router';\nimport { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';\nimport * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';\n// DocumentScanner 将在需要时动态导入（因为它在 Expo Go 中不可用）\nimport Constants from 'expo-constants';\nimport { getAllReceipts, deleteReceipt, saveReceipt } from '@/lib/database';\nimport { Receipt, ReceiptStatus } from '@/types';\nimport { format } from 'date-fns';\nimport { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';\nimport { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { SwipeableRow } from './SwipeableRow';\nimport { uploadReceiptImageTemp } from '@/lib/supabase';\nimport { processReceiptInBackground } from '@/lib/receipt-processor';\nimport { processImageForUpload } from '@/lib/image-processor';\n\n// 分组类型：\n// - month: 按交易时间（票面日期）的月份分组\n// - recordDate: 按记录时间（创建时间）的日期分组（按天）\n// - paymentAccount: 按支付账户分组\n// - createdBy: 按提交人分组\ntype GroupByType = 'month' | 'recordDate' | 'paymentAccount' | 'createdBy';\n\nconst statusColors: Record\u003cReceiptStatus, string\u003e = {\n  pending: '#FF9500',\n,\n};",

        "contents": "export default function ReceiptsScreen() {\nconst filterOptions = () =\u003e {\nreceipt =\u003e {\n\n      } else {\n        accounts.set('none', 'Not Set');\n      }\n\n      // 提交人\n      if (receipt.createdBy) {\n        const userName = receipt.createdByUser?.name || receipt.createdByUser?.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Unknown';\n        creators.set(receipt.createdBy, userName);\n      } else {\n        creators.set('unknown', 'Unknown');\n      }\n    });\n\n    // 将月份转换为排序后的数组\n    const sortedMonths = Array.from(months).sort((a, b) =\u003e b.localeCompare(a));\n    // 将记录时间（天）转换为排序后的数组\n    const sortedRecordDates = Array.from(recordDates).sort((a, b) =\u003e b.localeCompare(a));\n\n    return {\n      months: sortedMonths.map(monthKey =\u003e {\n        const [year, month] = monthKey.split('-');\n        const date = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(month) - 1);\n        return {\n          key: monthKey,\n          label: format(date, 'MMMM yyyy'),\n        };\n      }),\n      recordDates: sortedRecordDates.map(dayKey =\u003e {\n        const [year, month, day] = dayKey.split('-');\n        const date = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(month) - 1, parseInt(day));\n        return {\n          key: dayKey,\n          label: format(date, 'MMM dd, yyyy'),\n        };\n      }),\n      accounts: Array.from(accounts.entries()).map(([id, name]) =\u003e ({ id, name })),\n      creators: Array.from(creators.entries()).map(([id, name]) =\u003e ({ id, name })),\n    };\n  }, [receipts]);\n\n  // 搜索小票（在筛选后的结果中搜索）\n  const searchedReceipts = useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    if (!searchQuery.trim()) {\n      return filteredReceipts;\n    }\n\n    const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();\n    \n    return filteredReceipts.filter(receipt =\u003e {\n      // 搜索供应商名称（优先使用 supplier.name，兼容旧数据的 supplierName）\n      const displaySupplierName = receipt.supplier?.name || receipt.supplierName || '';\n      const supplierNameMatch = displaySupplierName.toLowerCase().includes(query);\n      \n      // 搜索商品明细名称\n      const itemsMatch = receipt.items?.some(item =\u003e \n        item.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query)\n      );\n      \n      return supplierNameMatch || itemsMatch;\n    });\n  },;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReceiptsScreen() {\n\n          \u003c/TouchableOpacity\u003e\n              \u003cView style={styles.searchContainer}\u003e\n                \u003cIonicons name=\"search\" size={18} color=\"#636E72\" style={styles.searchIcon} /\u003e\n                \u003cTextInput\n                  style={styles.searchInput}\n                  placeholder=\"Search\"\n                  placeholderTextColor=\"#95A5A6\"\n                  value={searchQuery}\n                  onChangeText={setSearchQuery}\n                /\u003e\n              \u003c/View\u003e\n              \u003cText style={styles.countText}\u003e{receipts.length}\u003c/Text\u003e\n            \u003c/\u003e\n          )}\n        \u003c/View\u003e\n      \u003c/View\u003e\n\n      \u003cSectionList\n        sections={sections.map(section =\u003e {\n          const isCollapsed = collapsedSections.has(section.monthKey);\n          return {\n            ...section,\n            data: isCollapsed ? [] : section.data,\n            // 保留原始数据用于统计\n            originalData: section.data,\n          };\n        })}\n        keyExtractor={(item: Receipt) =\u003e item.id || Math.random().toString()}\n        renderItem={({ item }: { item: Receipt }) =\u003e {\n          const isSelected = item.id ? selectedIds.has(item.id) : false;\n          const isSelectionMode = selectedIds.size \u003e 0;\n          \n          return (\n            \u003cSwipeableRow\n              onDelete={() =\u003e item.id \u0026\u0026 handleDeleteSingle(item.id)}\n              disabled={isSelectionMode}\n            \u003e\n          \u003cTouchableOpacity\n                style={[\n                  styles.receiptItem,\n                  isSelected \u0026\u0026 styles.receiptItemSelected,\n                ]}\n                onPress={() =\u003e {\n                  if (isSelectionMode) {\n                    if (item.id) handleToggleSelect(item.id);\n                  } else {\n                    router.push(&#96;/receipt-details/${item.id}&#96;);\n                  }\n                }}\n                onLongPress={() =\u003e {\n                  if (item.id \u0026\u0026 !isSelectionMode) {\n                    handleToggleSelect(item.id);\n                  }\n                }}\n        }\n}",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS receipts (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  household_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  store_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  total_amount DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,\n  date DATE NOT NULL,\n  payment_account_id UUID REFERENCES payment_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', -- 'pending', 'processing', 'confirmed'\n  image_url TEXT,\n  confidence DECIMAL(3, 2), -- 0.00 to 1.00\n  processed_by TEXT,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- 创建 receipt_items 表（添加 category_id 引用）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS receipt_items (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  receipt_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  category_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\n  purpose TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'Personnel', 'Business'\n  price DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,\n  is_asset BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  confidence DECIMAL(3, 2),\n  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_household_id ON users(household_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_categories_household_id ON categories(household_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payment_accounts_household_id ON payment_accounts(household_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_receipts_household_id ON receipts(household_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_receipts_date ON receipts(date DESC);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_receipts_status ON receipts(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_receipt_items_receipt_id ON receipt_items(receipt_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_receipt_items_category_id ON receipt_items(category_id);\n\n-- 创建 updated_at 自动更新触发器\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    NEW.updated_at = NOW();\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ language 'plpgsql';",

        "contents": "export default function ReceiptsScreen() {\nconst groupReceiptsByMonth = (receipts: Receipt[]): SectionData[] =\u003e {\nreceipt =\u003e {\n catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error parsing date:', receipt.date, error);\n      }\n    });\n\n    // 转换为数组并按月份倒序排列（最新的在前）\n    return Array.from(grouped.entries())\n      .map(([monthKey, data]) =\u003e {\n        const date = parseLocalDate(data[0].date);\n        return {\n          title: format(date, 'MMMM yyyy'),\n          monthKey,\n          data: data.sort((a, b) =\u003e parseLocalDate(b.date).getTime() - parseLocalDate(a.date).getTime()),\n        };\n      })\n      .sort((a, b) =\u003e b.monthKey.localeCompare(a.monthKey));\n  }, []);\n\n  // 按记录时间（创建时间，按天）分组小票\n  const groupReceiptsByRecordDate = useCallback((receipts: Receipt[]): SectionData[] =\u003e {\n    const grouped = new Map\u003cstring, Receipt[]\u003e();\n\n    receipts.forEach(receipt =\u003e {\n      try {\n        if (!receipt.createdAt) {\n          return;\n        }\n        const createdAt = new Date(receipt.createdAt);\n        const year = createdAt.getFullYear();\n        const month = String(createdAt.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\n        const day = String(createdAt.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n        const dayKey = &#96;record-${year}-${month}-${day}&#96;;\n\n        if (!grouped.has(dayKey)) {\n          grouped.set(dayKey, []);\n        }\n        grouped.get(dayKey)!.push(receipt);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error parsing createdAt:', receipt.createdAt, error);\n      }\n    });\n\n    // 转换为数组并按日期倒序排列（最新的在前）\n    return Array.from(grouped.entries())\n      .map(([dayKey, data]) =\u003e {\n        const sample = data[0];\n        const baseDate = sample.createdAt ? new Date(sample.createdAt) : parseLocalDate(sample.date);\n        const dateOnly = new Date(\n          baseDate.getFullYear(),\n          baseDate.getMonth(),\n          baseDate.getDate()\n        );\n\n        return\n      }\n\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReceiptsScreen() {\n({ item }: { item: Receipt }) =\u003e {\n\n                      {statusLabels[item.status]}\n                    \u003c/Text\u003e\n                  \u003c/View\u003e\n                )}\n                  \u003c/View\u003e\n                  \u003cView style={styles.secondRow}\u003e\n                    \u003cText style={styles.amount}\u003e${item.totalAmount.toFixed(2)}\u003c/Text\u003e\n                    \u003cText style={styles.date}\u003e{formatDate(item.date)}\u003c/Text\u003e\n                    \u003cText style={styles.createdDate}\u003e\n                      {item.createdAt ?         "contents": "export async function getAllReceipts(): Promise\u003cReceipt[]\u003e {\n(row: any) =\u003e (\n\n        email: row.created_by_user.email,\n        name: row.created_by_user.name,\n        spaceId: row.created_by_user.current_space_id,\n      } : undefined,\n      items: (row.receipt_items || []).map((item: any) =\u003e ({\n        id: item.id,\n        name: item.name,\n        categoryId: item.category_id,\n        category: item.categories ? {\n          id: item.categories.id,\n          spaceId: item.categories.space_id,\n          name: item.categories.name,\n          color: item.categories.color,\n          isDefault: item.categories.is_default,\n          createdAt: item.categories.created_at,\n          updatedAt: item.categories.updated_at,\n        } : undefined,\n        purposeId: item.purpose_id ?? null,\n        purpose: item.purposes ? {\n          id: item.purposes.id,\n          spaceId: item.purposes.space_id,\n          name: item.purposes.name,\n          color: item.purposes.color,\n          isDefault: item.purposes.is_default,\n          createdAt: item.purposes.created_at,\n          updatedAt: item.purposes.updated_at,\n        } : undefined,\n        price: item.price,\n        isAsset: item.is_asset,\n        confidence: item.confidence,\n      })),\n    }));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching receipts:', error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function saveReceipt(receipt: Receipt): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n\n    }\n\n    // 处理支付账户ID\n    let paymentAccountId = receipt.paymentAccountId;\n    if (!paymentAccountId \u0026\u0026 receipt.paymentAccount) {\n      const account = await findOrCreatePaymentAccount(receipt.paymentAccount.name || receipt.paymentAccount.id, true);\n      paymentAccountId = account.id;\n    }\n\n    // 先保存小票主记录\n    const { data: receiptData, error: receiptError } = await supabase\n      .from('receipts')\n      .insert({\n        space_id: spaceId,\n        supplier_name: receipt.supplierName || receipt.storeName,\n        supplier_id: supplierId,\n        total_amount: receipt.totalAmount,\n        currency: receipt.currency,\n        tax: receipt.tax,\n        date: receipt.date,\n        payment_account_id: paymentAccountId,\n        status: receipt.status,\n        image_url: receipt.imageUrl,\n        confidence: receipt.confidence,\n        processed_by: receipt.processedBy,\n        created_by: user.id, // 记录提交者\n      })\n      .select()\n      .single();\n\n    if (receiptError) {\n      console.error('Receipt insert error:', receiptError);\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "CREATE TABLE purposes (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  household_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  color TEXT DEFAULT '#95A5A6',\n  is_default BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),\n  UNIQUE(household_id, name)\n);\n\n-- 创建 receipts 表\nCREATE TABLE receipts (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  household_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  store_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  total_amount DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,\n  currency TEXT,\n  tax DECIMAL(10, 2),\n  date DATE NOT NULL,\n  payment_account_id UUID REFERENCES payment_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', -- 'pending', 'processing', 'confirmed', 'duplicate'\n  image_url TEXT,\n  confidence DECIMAL(3, 2), -- 0.00 to 1.00\n  processed_by TEXT,\n  created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- 创建 receipt_items 表\nCREATE TABLE receipt_items (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  receipt_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  category_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\n  purpose_id UUID REFERENCES purposes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n  price DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,\n  is_asset BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  confidence DECIMAL(3, 2),\n  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- 创建 household_invitations 表（家庭邀请）\nCREATE TABLE household_invitations (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),",

        "contents": "export default function ReceiptsScreen() {\nconst groupReceiptsByRecordDate = (receipts: Receipt[]): SectionData[] =\u003e {\n\n([dayKey, data]) =\u003e {\nconst dateOnly = new (\n          baseDate.getFullYear(),\n          baseDate.getMonth(),\n          baseDate.getDate()\n        );\n\n        return {\n          title: format(dateOnly, 'MMM dd, yyyy'),\n          monthKey: dayKey,\n          data: data.slice().sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n            const aTime = a.createdAt ? new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() : parseLocalDate(a.date).getTime();\n            const bTime = b.createdAt ? new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() : parseLocalDate(b.date).getTime();\n            return bTime - aTime;\n          }),\n        };\n      })\n      .sort((a, b) =\u003e b.monthKey.localeCompare(a.monthKey));\n  }, []);\n\n  // 按支付账户分组小票\n  const groupReceiptsByPaymentAccount = useCallback((receipts: Receipt[]): SectionData[] =\u003e {\n    const grouped = new Map\u003cstring, Receipt[]\u003e();\n    \n    receipts.forEach(receipt =\u003e {\n      const accountName = receipt.paymentAccount?.name || 'Not Set';\n      const accountKey = &#96;account-${receipt.paymentAccount?.id || 'none'}&#96;;\n      \n      if (!grouped.has(accountKey)) {\n        grouped.set(accountKey, []);\n      }\n      grouped.get(accountKey)!.push(receipt);\n    });\n\n    // 转换为数组并按账户名称排序\n    return Array.from(grouped.entries())\n      .map\n\n\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 创建 RPC 函数来更新邀请状态（绕过 RLS）\n-- 用于管理员移除成员时更新邀请状态为 'removed'\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：确保 CHECK 约束包含 'removed' 状态\nALTER TABLE household_invitations\n  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS valid_status;\n\nALTER TABLE household_invitations\n  ADD CONSTRAINT valid_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'declined', 'removed'));\n\n-- 第二步：创建 RPC 函数来更新邀请状态\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_invitation_status(\n  p_invitation_id UUID,\n  p_new_status TEXT\n)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_household_id UUID;\n  v_user_id UUID;\n  v_is_admin BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n  -- 获取当前用户ID\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n  \n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User must be authenticated';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 验证状态值\n  IF p_new_status NOT IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'declined', 'removed') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid status: %', p_new_status;\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 获取邀请记录的家庭ID\n  SELECT household_id INTO v_household_id\n  FROM household_invitations\n  WHERE id = p_invitation_id;\n  \n  IF v_household_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invitation not found';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 检查用户是否是该家庭的管理员\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM user_households \n    WHERE user_id = v_user_id \n      AND household_id = v_household_id \n      AND is_admin = TRUE\n  ) INTO v_is_admin;\n  \n  IF NOT v_is_admin THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only admins can update invitation status';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 更新邀请状态（绕过 RLS）\n  UPDATE household_invitations\n  SET status = p_new_status\n  WHERE id = p_invitation_id;\n  \n  RETURN TRUE;\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 授予权限：允许已认证用户调用此函数\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION update_invitation_status(UUID, TEXT) TO authenticated;\n\n-- 第三步：创建批量更新邀请状态的 RPC 函数",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复邀请表以支持 'removed' 状态\n-- 1. 修改 CHECK 约束以支持 'removed' 状态\n-- 2. 更新 RLS 策略以允许管理员更新自己家庭的邀请记录\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：删除现有的 CHECK 约束\nALTER TABLE household_invitations\n  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS valid_status;\n\n-- 第二步：重新创建 CHECK 约束，包含 'removed' 和 'declined' 状态\nALTER TABLE household_invitations\n  ADD CONSTRAINT valid_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'declined', 'removed'));\n\n-- 第三步：删除现有的 UPDATE 策略\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"household_invitations_update\" ON household_invitations;\n\n-- 第四步：创建新的 UPDATE 策略，允许：\n-- 1. 用户更新自己收到的邀请（接受/拒绝邀请）\n-- 2. 管理员更新自己家庭的邀请记录（移除成员时更新状态）\nCREATE POLICY \"household_invitations_update\" ON household_invitations\n  FOR UPDATE\n  USING (\n    -- 用户可以更新自己收到的邀请（通过 email 匹配，使用 auth.users）\n    invitee_email = (\n      SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n    )\n    -- 或者管理员可以更新自己家庭的邀请记录\n    OR household_id IN (\n      SELECT household_id \n      FROM user_households \n      WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND is_admin = TRUE\n    )\n  )\n  WITH CHECK (\n    -- 确保更新后：\n    -- 1. 如果是自己的邀请，保持是自己的邀请\n    -- 2. 如果是管理员更新，必须是管理员所属家庭的邀请\n    (\n      invitee_email = (\n        SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n      )\n    )\n    OR (\n      household_id IN (\n        SELECT household_id \n        FROM user_households \n        WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND is_admin = TRUE\n      )\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第五步：验证约束已更新\nSELECT \n    '✅ Status constraint updated' as status,",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表的 RLS 策略，解决 household_invitations INSERT 权限问题\n-- 问题：复杂的 users SELECT 策略在 INSERT 操作时触发权限错误\n-- 解决方案：简化 users 表的策略，避免在 RLS 检查时触发循环依赖\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n          AND cmd = 'SELECT'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped users SELECT policy: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第二步：创建简化的 users SELECT 策略\n-- 策略1：用户可以查看自己的记录（最重要，必须放在第一位）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 策略2：用户可以查看同一家庭的成员\n-- 注意：使用 SECURITY DEFINER 函数来避免 RLS 循环依赖\n-- 如果函数不存在，使用简单的子查询\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_household_members\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    -- 使用 EXISTS 子查询，避免复杂的 JOIN\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 \n          FROM user_households uh2\n          WHERE uh2.household_id = uh1.household_id\n            AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n            AND uh2.user_id != auth.uid()\n        )\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 策略3：用户可以查看邀请者（用于显示邀请信息）\n-- 注意：简化策略，避免复杂的 JOIN\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_inviters\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT ",

        "contents": "export async function updateReceipt(receiptId: string, receipt: Partial\u003cReceipt\u003e): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n// 获取所有小票（当前家庭的）\nexport async function getAllReceipts(): Promise\u003cReceipt[]\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) throw new Error('No space selected');\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('receipts')\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        suppliers (*),\n        payment_accounts (*),\n        created_by_user:users!created_by (\n          id,\n          email,\n          name,\n          current_space_id\n        ),\n        receipt_items (\n          *,\n          categories (*),\n          purposes (*)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n                .eq('space_id', spaceId)\n      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })\n      .order('created_at', { foreignTable: 'receipt_items', ascending: true });\n\n    if (error) throw error;\n\n    return\n}",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 创建 users 表的 RPC 函数\n-- 使用 SECURITY DEFINER 绕过 RLS 限制\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：创建更新用户名字的函数\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_user_name(p_user_id UUID, p_name TEXT)\nRETURNS void\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  -- 验证用户 ID 是否匹配\n  IF p_user_id != auth.uid() THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Can only update own record';\n  END IF;\n  \n  UPDATE users\n  SET name = p_name\n  WHERE id = p_user_id;\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 第二步：创建更新用户当前家庭的函数\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_user_current_household(p_user_id UUID, p_household_id UUID)\nRETURNS void\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  -- 验证用户 ID 是否匹配\n  IF p_user_id != auth.uid() THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Can only update own record';\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- 验证用户是否属于该家庭\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM user_households \n    WHERE user_id = p_user_id \n      AND household_id = p_household_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User does not belong to this household';\n  END IF;\n  \n  UPDATE users\n  SET current_household_id = p_household_id\n  WHERE id = p_user_id;\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 第三步：创建查询同家庭用户的函数\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_household_member_users(p_household_id UUID)\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  id UUID,\n  email TEXT,\n  name TEXT,\n  current_household_id UUID,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  -- 验证当前用户是否属于该家庭",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表的 SELECT RLS 策略\n-- 允许用户查询自己的记录，即使还没有 household\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：检查当前的 users SELECT 策略\nSELECT \n    'Current Policies' as check_type,\n    policyname,\n    cmd,\n    qual,\n    with_check\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\n  AND cmd = 'SELECT'\nORDER BY policyname;\n\n-- 第二步：删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n          AND cmd = 'SELECT'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped SELECT policy: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第三步：创建新的 SELECT 策略\n-- 策略1：用户可以查看自己的记录（关键：即使没有 household 也能查看）\n-- 这是最重要的策略，必须放在第一位\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 策略2：用户可以查看同一家庭的成员（通过 user_households 关联）\n-- 注意：只有当用户已经在某个家庭中时才适用\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_household_members\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    -- 确保用户至少属于一个家庭\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n    AND\n    -- 查看同一家庭的其他成员\n    id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第四步：验证策略已创建\nSELECT \n    'Policy Verification' as check_type,\n    policyname,\n    cmd,\n    roles,",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "BEGIN\n  -- 验证当前用户是否属于该家庭\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM user_households \n    WHERE user_id = auth.uid() \n      AND household_id = p_household_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User does not belong to this household';\n  END IF;\n  \n  RETURN QUERY\n  SELECT \n    u.id,\n    u.email,\n    u.name,\n    u.current_household_id,\n    u.created_at\n  FROM users u\n  INNER JOIN user_households uh ON u.id = uh.user_id\n  WHERE uh.household_id = p_household_id;\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 第四步：创建查询邀请者的函数\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_inviter_users()\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  id UUID,\n  email TEXT,\n  name TEXT\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_email TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- 获取当前用户的 email（明确指定表别名）\n  SELECT au.email INTO v_user_email\n  FROM auth.users au\n  WHERE au.id = auth.uid();\n  \n  IF v_user_email IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  \n  RETURN QUERY\n  SELECT \n    u.id,\n    u.email,\n    u.name\n  FROM users u\n  INNER JOIN household_invitations hi ON u.id = hi.inviter_id\n  WHERE hi.invitee_email = v_user_email\n    AND hi.status = 'pending'\n    AND hi.expires_at \u003e NOW();\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 第五步：确保这些函数的拥有者是 postgres（这样在默认 RLS 模式下可以绕过 users 表的 RLS）\n-- 注意：这一步必须在 Supabase SQL Editor 中以 postgres 超级用户身份执行才会生效\nALTER FUNCTION update_user_name(UUID, TEXT) OWNER TO postgres;\nALTER FUNCTION update_user_current_household(UUID, UUID) OWNER TO postgres;\nALTER FUNCTION get_household_member_users(UUID) OWNER TO postgres;\nALTER FUNCTION get_inviter_users() OWNER TO postgres;\n\n-- 第六步：授予函数执行权限\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION update_user_name(UUID, TEXT) TO authenticated;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION update_user_current_household(UUID, UUID) TO authenticated;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION get_household_member_users(UUID) TO authenticated;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION get_inviter_users() TO authenticated;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 get_inviter_users 函数\n-- 解决 \"column reference 'email' is ambiguous\" 错误\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 重新创建 get_inviter_users 函数，修复 email 歧义问题\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_inviter_users()\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  id UUID,\n  email TEXT,\n  name TEXT\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_email TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- 获取当前用户的 email（明确指定表别名 au，避免歧义）\n  SELECT au.email INTO v_user_email\n  FROM auth.users au\n  WHERE au.id = auth.uid();\n  \n  IF v_user_email IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  \n  RETURN QUERY\n  SELECT \n    u.id,\n    u.email,\n    u.name\n  FROM users u\n  INNER JOIN household_invitations hi ON u.id = hi.inviter_id\n  WHERE hi.invitee_email = v_user_email\n    AND hi.status = 'pending'\n    AND hi.expires_at \u003e NOW();\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 验证函数已修复\nSELECT \n    '✅ Function fixed' as status,\n    routine_name,\n    security_type\nFROM information_schema.routines\nWHERE routine_schema = 'public' \n  AND routine_name = 'get_inviter_users';",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表 SELECT 策略，允许用户查看自己的记录\n-- 同时修复 household_invitations 表的 RLS 策略，确保不查询 users 表\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：修复 get_user_household_id() 函数（优先从 user_households 表获取，避免查询 users 表）\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    -- 优先从 user_households 表获取（不查询 users 表）\n    (SELECT household_id FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1),\n    -- 如果 user_households 没有，尝试从 users.current_household_id 获取（如果字段存在）\n    (SELECT current_household_id FROM users WHERE id = auth.uid() AND current_household_id IS NOT NULL)\n  );\n$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 第二步：确保 users 表有正确的 SELECT 策略（允许用户查看自己的记录）\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    -- 删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 user_households 表的 RLS 策略\n-- 确保同一家庭的成员可以互相查看\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 1. 删除所有现有的 user_households SELECT 策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'user_households' AND cmd = 'SELECT') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON user_households';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 2. 创建一个辅助函数来检查用户是否属于某个家庭\n-- 使用 SECURITY DEFINER 和直接查询来绕过 RLS，避免递归\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION user_belongs_to_household(p_household_id UUID)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nSTABLE\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  -- 直接查询 user_households 表，使用 SECURITY DEFINER 绕过 RLS\n  -- 这样就不会触发递归\n  RETURN EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM user_households \n    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n      AND household_id = p_household_id\n  );\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 授予函数执行权限\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION user_belongs_to_household(UUID) TO authenticated;\n\n-- 3. 创建新的 SELECT 策略\n-- 允许用户查看同一家庭的所有成员（通过household_id匹配）\n-- 使用辅助函数避免递归（函数内部使用 SECURITY DEFINER 绕过 RLS）\nCREATE POLICY \"user_households_select_same_household\" ON user_households\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己所属的家庭的所有成员\n    -- 使用辅助函数，函数内部使用 SECURITY DEFINER 绕过 RLS，避免递归\n    user_belongs_to_household(household_id)\n  );\n\n-- 4. 验证策略和函数已创建\nSELECT \n    '✅ user_households RLS 策略已修复' as result,\n    tablename, \n    policyname, \n    cmd\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'user_households'\nORDER BY cmd, policyname;\n\n-- 5. 验证函数已创建\nSELECT \n    '✅ 辅助函数已创建' as result,\n    routine_name,",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "-- 修复 user_households 表的 RLS 策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "-- 确保同一家庭的成员可以互相查看"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "-- 1. 删除所有现有的 user_households SELECT 策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "DO $$"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "DECLARE"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "    r RECORD;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "BEGIN"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'user_households' AND cmd = 'SELECT') LOOP"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON user_households';"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "    END LOOP;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "END $$;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "-- 2. 创建一个辅助函数来检查用户是否属于某个家庭"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "-- 使用 SECURITY DEFINER 和直接查询来绕过 RLS，避免递归"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION user_belongs_to_household(p_household_id UUID)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "RETURNS BOOLEAN"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "LANGUAGE plpgsql"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "SECURITY DEFINER"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "SET search_path = public"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "STABLE"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "AS $$"

          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "BEGIN"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "  -- 直接查询 user_households 表，使用 SECURITY DEFINER 绕过 RLS"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "  -- 这样就不会触发递归"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "  RETURN EXISTS ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "    SELECT 1 "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "    FROM user_households "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()"

            "lineNumber": 32,

            "text": "END;"

          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "$$;"

          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "-- 授予函数执行权限"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION user_belongs_to_household(UUID) TO authenticated;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "-- 3. 创建新的 SELECT 策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "-- 允许用户查看同一家庭的所有成员（通过household_id匹配）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "-- 使用辅助函数避免递归（函数内部使用 SECURITY DEFINER 绕过 RLS）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "CREATE POLICY \"user_households_select_same_household\" ON user_households"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "  FOR SELECT "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "  USING ("
          },

            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "    -- 用户可以查看自己所属的家庭的所有成员"

            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "    -- 使用辅助函数，函数内部使用 SECURITY DEFINER 绕过 RLS，避免递归"

          {

            "text": "    user_belongs_to_household(household_id)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "  );"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "-- 4. 验证策略和函数已创建"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "SELECT "
          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- 修复 users 表的 RLS SELECT 策略以支持多家庭系统\n-- 允许同一家庭的用户查看其他成员的email和name\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n\n-- 1. 创建函数：检查两个用户是否在同一家庭（使用 SECURITY DEFINER 避免递归）\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION users_in_same_household(p_current_user_id UUID, p_target_user_id UUID)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nLANGUAGE sql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\n  -- 检查两个用户是否有共同的家庭\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM user_households uh1\n    INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n    WHERE uh1.user_id = p_current_user_id\n      AND uh2.user_id = p_target_user_id\n  );\n$$;\n\n-- 2. 删除现有的 users SELECT 策略\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can view users in their household\" ON users;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"users_select_policy\" ON users;\n\n-- 3. 创建新的 SELECT 策略：\n-- 用户可以查看同一家庭中所有成员的信息，或者自己的信息\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己的记录\n    id = auth.uid()\n    OR\n    -- 或者用户可以查看同一家庭中其他成员的记录\n    -- 使用 SECURITY DEFINER 函数来检查，避免递归\n    users_in_same_household(auth.uid(), users.id)\n  );\n\n-- 5. 验证策略已创建\nSELECT \n    tablename, \n    policyname, \n    cmd,\n    qual,\n    with_check\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\n  AND policyname = 'users_select_policy';",
        "detailedLines": [
          {

            "text": "-- 2. 删除现有的 users SELECT 策略"

            "text": "DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can view users in their household\" ON users;"

            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "CREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users"

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export async function getMostFrequentCurrency(): Promise\u003cstring | null\u003e {\n {\n    console.warn('Error getting most frequent currency:', error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n// 根据ID获取小票\nexport async function getReceiptById(receiptId: string): Promise\u003cReceipt | null\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) throw new Error('No space selected');\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('receipts')\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        suppliers (*),\n        payment_accounts (*),\n        created_by_user:users!created_by (\n          id,\n          email,\n          name,\n          current_space_id\n        ),\n        receipt_items (\n          *,\n          categories (*),\n          purposes (*)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq('id', receiptId)\n                .eq('space_id', spaceId)\n      .order('created_at', { foreignTable: 'receipt_items', ascending: true })\n      .single();\n\n    if (error) {\n      if (error.code === 'PGRST116') return null; // Not found\n      throw error;\n    }\n    if (!data) return null;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "  USING (\n    -- 条件1：用户可以查看自己的记录（最基本的权限，必须放在第一位）\n    id = auth.uid() \n    -- 条件2：用户可以查看邀请者的信息（用于显示邀请对话框）\n    -- 如果当前用户有 pending 邀请，且该用户的 id 是邀请者（inviter_id）\n    -- 注意：使用 auth.users 表获取 email，避免递归查询 users 表\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT inviter_id \n      FROM household_invitations \n      WHERE invitee_email = (\n        SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n      )\n      AND status = 'pending'\n      AND expires_at \u003e NOW()\n    )\n    -- 条件3：用户可以查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    -- 注意：不查询 users 表的 current_household_id，而是直接通过 user_households 表关联\n    -- 这个策略允许用户查看与自己同家庭的所有其他用户（用于显示家庭成员列表）\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id\n      FROM user_households uh1\n      JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id != auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第三步：创建 users INSERT 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_policy\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT \n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 第四步：创建 users UPDATE 策略\n-- 允许用户更新自己的记录（包括 current_household_id）\n-- 用于切换家庭时更新 current_household_id\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update_policy\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE\n  USING (id = auth.uid())\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 第五步：验证策略已创建\nSELECT \n    '✅ Policy created' as status,\n    tablename, \n    policyname, \n    cmd,\n    qual as using_clause\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\nORDER BY policyname;\n\n-- 第六步：验证 RLS 已启用\nSELECT \n    '✅ RLS status' as status,\n    tablename, \n    rowsecurity as rls_enabled\nFROM pg_tables \nWHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users';\n\n-- 说明：",
