        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表的 RLS 策略，允许查询同家庭的用户信息\n-- 解决所有查询用户信息时的权限问题\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：确保 get_user_household_id() 函数存在且正确\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    -- 优先使用 current_household_id\n    (SELECT current_household_id FROM users WHERE id = auth.uid()),\n    -- 如果为 NULL，从 user_households 表获取第一个家庭\n    (SELECT household_id FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1)\n  );\n$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 第二步：删除所有现有的 users 表策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped policy: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第三步：重新创建 users 表的 RLS 策略\n\n-- SELECT: 允许用户查看同家庭的用户或自己\n-- 使用 user_households 表来检查是否在同一家庭\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_same_household\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    -- 允许查看自己（最重要，必须放在第一位）\n    id = auth.uid()\n    OR\n    -- 允许查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n    )\n  );\n\n-- INSERT: 允许用户创建自己的记录（注册时需要）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_own_record\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT \n  TO authenticated\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- UPDATE: 用户只能更新自己的记录\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update_own_record\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复根本原因：get_user_household_id 函数查询 users 表\n-- 这是导致 \"permission denied for table users\" 错误的根本原因\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：检查 INSERT 策略是否使用了 get_user_household_id 函数\nSELECT \n    '=== 检查 INSERT 策略是否使用 get_user_household_id ===' as section,\n    policyname,\n    with_check,\n    CASE \n        WHEN with_check LIKE '%get_user_household_id%' THEN '❌ 使用了 get_user_household_id 函数（这是问题！）'\n        ELSE '✅ 没有使用 get_user_household_id 函数'\n    END as status\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'household_invitations'\n  AND cmd = 'INSERT';\n\n-- 第二步：修复 get_user_household_id 函数（完全不查询 users 表）\n-- 只从 user_households 表获取，不查询 users 表\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  -- 只从 user_households 表获取，完全不查询 users 表\n  SELECT household_id \n  FROM user_households \n  WHERE user_id = auth.uid() \n  ORDER BY is_admin DESC, created_at ASC\n  LIMIT 1;\n$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 验证函数已修复\nSELECT \n    '=== 验证函数已修复 ===' as section,\n    routine_name,\n    routine_definition,\n    CASE \n        WHEN routine_definition LIKE '%FROM users%' \n          OR routine_definition LIKE '%JOIN users%'\n          OR routine_definition LIKE '%public.users%' THEN '❌ 仍然查询 users 表'\n        ELSE '✅ 不查询 users 表（已修复）'\n    END as status\nFROM information_schema.routines\nWHERE routine_schema = 'public'\n  AND routine_name = 'get_user_household_id';\n\n-- 第三步：重新创建 INSERT 策略（确保不查询 users 表）\n-- 如果策略使用了 get_user_household_id 函数，现在应该可以正常工作了\n-- 但为了保险，我们重新创建一个完全不依赖 users 表的策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    -- 删除所有现有的 household_invitations INSERT 策略",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 正确修复：允许在 RLS 策略中查询 users 表\n-- 正常开放 users 表的权限策略，不绕过\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：确保 get_user_household_id() 函数可以查询 users 表\n-- 使用 SECURITY DEFINER，这样函数可以在自己的权限下查询 users 表\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  -- 可以从 users 表获取（使用 SECURITY DEFINER，可以绕过 RLS）\n  -- 优先从 user_households 表获取（更准确，因为用户可能在多个家庭）\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    -- 优先从 user_households 表获取（不查询 users 表，更安全）\n    (SELECT household_id FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid() ORDER BY is_admin DESC, created_at ASC LIMIT 1),\n    -- 如果 user_households 没有，从 users 表获取（如果需要的话）\n    (SELECT current_household_id FROM users WHERE id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1)\n  );\n$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 第二步：确保 users 表的 SELECT 策略允许查询自己的记录\n-- 这对于 RLS 策略上下文中的查询非常重要\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\n    has_select_policy BOOLEAN := FALSE;\nBEGIN\n    -- 检查是否已有允许查询自己记录的 SELECT 策略",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "    CREATE POLICY \"users_select_for_rls\" ON users\n      FOR SELECT \n      TO authenticated\n      USING (\n        -- 允许查询自己的记录（最基本）\n        id = auth.uid()\n        OR\n        -- 允许查询同家庭的记录（通过 get_user_household_id 函数）\n        current_household_id = get_user_household_id()\n        OR\n        -- 允许通过 user_households 表查询同家庭的记录\n        EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 \n          FROM user_households uh1\n          JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n          WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n            AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n        )\n        OR\n        -- 最关键：允许查询任何与当前用户在同一家庭的用户记录\n        -- 这确保了在 RLS 策略上下文中可以查询 users 表\n        EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 \n          FROM user_households\n          WHERE user_households.user_id = auth.uid()\n            AND EXISTS (\n              SELECT 1 \n              FROM user_households uh2\n              WHERE uh2.user_id = users.id\n                AND uh2.household_id = user_households.household_id\n            )\n        )\n      );\n    \n    RAISE NOTICE '✅ 创建了宽松的 users SELECT 策略（允许在 RLS 上下文中查询）';\nEND $$;\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第四部分：修复 user_households 表的 SELECT 策略\n-- ============================================\n\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    -- 删除所有现有的 user_households SELECT 策略",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 完整解决方案：修复 users 表 RLS 问题\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：创建或替换 SECURITY DEFINER 函数\n-- 这个函数会绕过 RLS，直接查询 users 表\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_by_id(p_user_id UUID)\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  id UUID,\n  email TEXT,\n  name TEXT,\n  current_household_id UUID,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE\n) \nLANGUAGE plpgsql \nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  RETURN QUERY\n  SELECT \n    u.id,\n    u.email,\n    u.name,\n    u.current_household_id,\n    u.created_at\n  FROM users u\n  WHERE u.id = p_user_id;\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 第二步：授予函数执行权限\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION get_user_by_id(UUID) TO authenticated;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION get_user_by_id(UUID) TO anon;\n\n-- 第三步：删除所有现有的 users 表策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON users';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第四步：创建最简单的 RLS 策略\n-- 只允许用户查看自己的记录（最基本的权限）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 创建 INSERT 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_own\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT \n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 创建 UPDATE 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update_own\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE\n  USING (id = auth.uid())\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 第五步：验证函数和策略\nSELECT \n    'Function created' as status,\n    routine_name,\n    security_type\nFROM information_schema.routines\nWHERE routine_schema = 'public' \n  AND routine_name = 'get_user_by_id';\n\nSELECT \n    'Policy created' as status,\n    tablename, \n    policyname, \n    cmd,\n    qual as using_clause\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\nORDER BY policyname;",

        "contents": "BEGIN\n    NEW.updated_at = NOW();\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ language 'plpgsql';\n\nCREATE TRIGGER update_households_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON households\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();\n\nCREATE TRIGGER update_categories_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON categories\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();\n\nCREATE TRIGGER update_payment_accounts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_accounts\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();\n\nCREATE TRIGGER update_receipts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON receipts\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();\n\n-- 启用 Row Level Security (RLS)\nALTER TABLE households ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE categories ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE payment_accounts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE receipts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE receipt_items ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n-- 创建 RLS 策略：用户只能访问自己家庭的数据\n-- 获取用户家庭ID的函数\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  SELECT household_id FROM users WHERE id = auth.uid();\n$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- Households 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view their household\" ON households\n  FOR SELECT USING (id = get_user_household_id());\n\n-- Users 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view users in their household\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT USING (household_id = get_user_household_id());\n\n-- Categories 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can manage categories in their household\" ON categories\n  FOR ALL USING (household_id = get_user_household_id())\n  WITH CHECK (household_id = get_user_household_id());\n\n-- Payment Accounts 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can manage payment accounts in their household\" ON payment_accounts\n  FOR ALL USING (household_id = get_user_household_id())\n  WITH CHECK (household_id = get_user_household_id());\n\n-- Receipts 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can manage receipts in their household\" ON receipts\n  FOR ALL USING (household_id = get_user_household_id())",

            "text": "-- 启用 Row Level Security (RLS)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105,
            "text": "ALTER TABLE households ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;"

            "lineNumber": 106,
            "text": "ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;"

            "text": "ALTER TABLE receipts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;"

            "text": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()"

            "text": "RETURNS UUID AS $$"

            "text": "CREATE POLICY \"Users can view users in their household\" ON users"

            "text": "  FOR SELECT USING (household_id = get_user_household_id());"

        "contents": "    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第四步：重新创建 receipts 策略（使用更宽松的检查，避免 NULL 问题）\n-- SELECT: 用户可以查看自己家庭的小票\nCREATE POLICY \"receipts_select\" ON receipts\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    household_id IS NOT NULL \n    AND household_id = get_user_household_id()\n  );\n\n-- INSERT: 用户可以创建自己家庭的小票\n-- 重要：使用 WITH CHECK 确保插入的 household_id 匹配用户的家庭\nCREATE POLICY \"receipts_insert\" ON receipts\n  FOR INSERT \n  WITH CHECK (\n    household_id IS NOT NULL \n    AND household_id = get_user_household_id()\n  );\n\n-- UPDATE: 用户可以更新自己家庭的小票\nCREATE POLICY \"receipts_update\" ON receipts\n  FOR UPDATE \n  USING (\n    household_id IS NOT NULL \n    AND household_id = get_user_household_id()\n  )\n  WITH CHECK (\n    household_id IS NOT NULL \n    AND household_id = get_user_household_id()\n  );\n\n-- DELETE: 用户可以删除自己家庭的小票\nCREATE POLICY \"receipts_delete\" ON receipts\n  FOR DELETE \n  USING (\n    household_id IS NOT NULL \n    AND household_id = get_user_household_id()\n  );\n\n-- 第五步：重新创建 receipt_items 策略\n-- SELECT: 用户可以查看自己家庭小票的商品项\nCREATE POLICY \"receipt_items_select\" ON receipt_items\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM receipts \n      WHERE receipts.id = receipt_items.receipt_id \n      AND receipts.household_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND receipts.household_id = get_user_household_id()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- INSERT: 用户可以为自己家庭的小票添加商品项\nCREATE POLICY \"receipt_items_insert\" ON receipt_items\n  FOR INSERT \n  WITH CHECK (\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM receipts \n      WHERE receipts.id = receipt_items.receipt_id \n      AND receipts.household_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND receipts.household_id = get_user_household_id()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- UPDATE: 用户可以更新自己家庭小票的商品项\nCREATE POLICY \"receipt_items_update\" ON receipt_items\n  FOR UPDATE ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 调整 users 表的 RLS 策略\n-- 给予被邀请者查询邀请者信息的权限\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：删除所有现有的 users 表策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON users';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第二步：创建 users SELECT 策略\n-- 允许用户查看：\n-- 1. 自己的记录\n-- 2. 邀请者的信息（如果当前用户有 pending 邀请）\n-- 3. 同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己的记录（最基本的权限，必须放在第一位）\n    id = auth.uid() \n    -- 或者用户可以查看邀请者的信息（用于显示邀请对话框）\n    -- 如果当前用户有 pending 邀请，且该用户的 id 是邀请者（inviter_id）\n    -- 注意：使用 auth.users 表获取 email，避免递归查询 users 表\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT inviter_id \n      FROM household_invitations \n      WHERE invitee_email = (\n        SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n      )\n      AND status = 'pending'\n      AND expires_at \u003e NOW()\n    )\n    -- 或者用户可以查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    -- 注意：不查询 users 表的 current_household_id，而是直接通过 user_households 表关联\n    -- 这个策略允许用户查看与自己同家庭的所有其他用户\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id\n      FROM user_households uh1\n      JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id != auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第三步：创建 users INSERT 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_policy\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT ",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表的 SELECT RLS 策略\n-- 允许用户查询自己的记录，即使还没有 household\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：检查当前的 users SELECT 策略\nSELECT \n    'Current Policies' as check_type,\n    policyname,\n    cmd,\n    qual,\n    with_check\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\n  AND cmd = 'SELECT'\nORDER BY policyname;\n\n-- 第二步：删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n          AND cmd = 'SELECT'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped SELECT policy: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第三步：创建新的 SELECT 策略\n-- 策略1：用户可以查看自己的记录（关键：即使没有 household 也能查看）\n-- 这是最重要的策略，必须放在第一位\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 策略2：用户可以查看同一家庭的成员（通过 user_households 关联）\n-- 注意：只有当用户已经在某个家庭中时才适用\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_household_members\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    -- 确保用户至少属于一个家庭\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n    AND\n    -- 查看同一家庭的其他成员\n    id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第四步：验证策略已创建\nSELECT \n    'Policy Verification' as check_type,\n    policyname,\n    cmd,\n    roles,",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "-- 修复 users 表的 SELECT RLS 策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "-- 允许用户查询自己的记录，即使还没有 household"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "-- 第一步：检查当前的 users SELECT 策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "SELECT "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "    'Current Policies' as check_type,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "    policyname,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "    cmd,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "    qual,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "    with_check"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "FROM pg_policies"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "WHERE schemaname = 'public' "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "  AND tablename = 'users'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "  AND cmd = 'SELECT'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "ORDER BY policyname;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "-- 第二步：删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "DO $$"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "DECLARE"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "    r RECORD;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "BEGIN"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "    FOR r IN ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "        SELECT policyname "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "        FROM pg_policies "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "        WHERE schemaname = 'public' "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "          AND tablename = 'users'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "          AND cmd = 'SELECT'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "    ) LOOP"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "        RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped SELECT policy: %', r.policyname;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "    END LOOP;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "END $$;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "-- 第三步：创建新的 SELECT 策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "-- 策略1：用户可以查看自己的记录（关键：即使没有 household 也能查看）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "-- 这是最重要的策略，必须放在第一位"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "CREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "  FOR SELECT "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "  TO authenticated"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "  USING (id = auth.uid());"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "-- 策略2：用户可以查看同一家庭的成员（通过 user_households 关联）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "-- 注意：只有当用户已经在某个家庭中时才适用"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "CREATE POLICY \"users_select_household_members\" ON users"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "  FOR SELECT "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "  TO authenticated"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "  USING ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "    -- 确保用户至少属于一个家庭"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "    EXISTS ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "      SELECT 1 FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "    )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "    AND"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "    -- 查看同一家庭的其他成员"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "    id IN ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58,
            "text": "      SELECT uh2.user_id "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59,
            "text": "      FROM user_households uh1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "      INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61,
            "text": "      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "    )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "  );"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65,
            "text": "-- 第四步：验证策略已创建"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66,
            "text": "SELECT "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "text": "    'Policy Verification' as check_type,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "    policyname,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69,
            "text": "    cmd,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "    roles,"
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 70
          },
          "startPosition": {}
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./fix-users-rls-select.sql",
        "signatures": {}
      },
      "score": 0.45173540711402893
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "CREATE POLICY \"payment_accounts_manage_policy\" ON payment_accounts\n  FOR ALL \n  USING (household_id = get_user_household_id())\n  WITH CHECK (household_id = get_user_household_id());\n\n-- ============================================\n-- Receipts 策略\n-- ============================================\nCREATE POLICY \"receipts_manage_policy\" ON receipts\n  FOR ALL \n  USING (household_id = get_user_household_id())\n  WITH CHECK (household_id = get_user_household_id());\n\n-- ============================================\n-- Receipt Items 策略\n-- ============================================\nCREATE POLICY \"receipt_items_manage_policy\" ON receipt_items\n  FOR ALL \n  USING (\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM receipts \n      WHERE receipts.id = receipt_items.receipt_id \n      AND receipts.household_id = get_user_household_id()\n    )\n  )\n  WITH CHECK (\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM receipts \n      WHERE receipts.id = receipt_items.receipt_id \n      AND receipts.household_id = get_user_household_id()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 验证策略\n-- ============================================\n-- 运行以下查询检查策略是否正确创建：\n-- SELECT schemaname, tablename, policyname, cmd, qual, with_check\n-- FROM pg_policies\n-- WHERE schemaname = 'public'\n-- ORDER BY tablename, policyname;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "BEGIN\n    RAISE NOTICE '=== 删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略 ===';\n    \n    -- 删除所有现有的 users SELECT 策略\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n          AND cmd = 'SELECT'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE '✅ 删除了旧策略: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\n    \n    RAISE NOTICE '=== 创建宽松的 users SELECT 策略（允许在 RLS 上下文中查询） ===';\n    \n    -- 创建宽松的 SELECT 策略：允许用户查看自己的记录（这是最基本的）\n    CREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users\n      FOR SELECT \n      TO authenticated\n      USING (id = auth.uid());\n    \n    -- 创建宽松的 SELECT 策略：允许用户查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    -- 这个策略允许在 RLS 策略上下文中查询同家庭的用户\n    CREATE POLICY \"users_select_same_household\" ON users\n      FOR SELECT \n      TO authenticated\n      USING (\n        EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 \n          FROM user_households uh1\n          INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n          WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n            AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n            AND users.id != auth.uid()\n        )\n      );\n    \n    -- 关键：创建额外的宽松策略，允许在 RLS 策略上下文中查询 users 表\n    -- 这对于在 RLS 策略的 WITH CHECK 子句中查询 users 表很重要\n    -- 允许查询当前用户的记录（即使是在 RLS 策略上下文中）\n    CREATE POLICY \"users_select_for_rls\" ON users\n      FOR SELECT ",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 诊断 RLS 问题\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本以检查当前状态\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 1. 检查 get_user_household_id() 函数是否存在\nSELECT \n    routine_name, \n    routine_type,\n    security_type,\n    routine_definition\nFROM information_schema.routines\nWHERE routine_schema = 'public' \n  AND routine_name = 'get_user_household_id';\n\n-- 2. 检查 receipts 表的 RLS 是否启用\nSELECT \n    tablename, \n    rowsecurity as rls_enabled\nFROM pg_tables \nWHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'receipts';\n\n-- 3. 检查 receipts 表的所有策略\nSELECT \n    policyname, \n    cmd as operation,\n    qual as using_clause,\n    with_check as with_check_clause,\n    roles\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'receipts'\nORDER BY policyname;\n\n-- 4. 检查 receipt_items 表的所有策略\nSELECT \n    policyname, \n    cmd as operation,\n    qual as using_clause,\n    with_check as with_check_clause,\n    roles\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'receipt_items'\nORDER BY policyname;\n\n-- 5. 检查当前登录用户（如果有）\n-- 注意：这个查询需要在有用户登录的情况下运行\nSELECT auth.uid() as current_user_id;",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "-- 诊断 RLS 问题"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本以检查当前状态"
          },

            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "-- 1. 检查 get_user_household_id() 函数是否存在"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "SELECT "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "    routine_name, "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "    routine_type,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "    security_type,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "    routine_definition"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "FROM information_schema.routines"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "WHERE routine_schema = 'public' "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "  AND routine_name = 'get_user_household_id';"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "-- 2. 检查 receipts 表的 RLS 是否启用"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "SELECT "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "    tablename, "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "    rowsecurity as rls_enabled"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "FROM pg_tables "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'receipts';"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "-- 3. 检查 receipts 表的所有策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "SELECT "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "    policyname, "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "    cmd as operation,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "    qual as using_clause,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "    with_check as with_check_clause,"
          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 使用 SECURITY DEFINER 函数绕过 RLS 限制\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：创建 SECURITY DEFINER 函数来获取用户信息\n-- 这个函数会绕过 RLS，直接查询 users 表\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_by_id(p_user_id UUID)\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  id UUID,\n  email TEXT,\n  name TEXT,\n  current_household_id UUID,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE\n) AS $$\nBEGIN\n  RETURN QUERY\n  SELECT \n    u.id,\n    u.email,\n    u.name,\n    u.current_household_id,\n    u.created_at\n  FROM users u\n  WHERE u.id = p_user_id;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 第二步：确保 users 表有最基本的 RLS 策略\n-- 删除所有现有策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON users';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 创建最简单的策略：只允许用户查看自己的记录\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_own\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  USING (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 创建 INSERT 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_own\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT \n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 创建 UPDATE 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update_own\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE\n  USING (id = auth.uid())\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 第三步：验证\nSELECT \n    tablename, \n    policyname, \n    cmd,\n    qual as using_clause\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\nORDER BY policyname;\n\n-- 第四步：授予函数执行权限（确保所有用户都能调用）\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION get_user_by_id(UUID) TO authenticated;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION get_user_by_id(UUID) TO anon;\n\n-- 第五步：验证函数已创建\nSELECT \n    routine_name, \n    routine_type,\n    security_type,\n    routine_definition\nFROM information_schema.routines\nWHERE routine_schema = 'public' \n  AND routine_name = 'get_user_by_id';",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 强制修复 receipts 表的 RLS 策略（更彻底的版本）\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：确保函数存在且正确\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\nBEGIN\n  -- 如果 users 表中还没有记录，返回 NULL 但不抛出错误\n  RETURN (SELECT household_id FROM users WHERE id = auth.uid());\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 第二步：强制删除所有现有策略（包括可能隐藏的策略）\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipts_select\" ON receipts;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipts_insert\" ON receipts;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipts_update\" ON receipts;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipts_delete\" ON receipts;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can manage receipts in their household\" ON receipts;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipts_manage_policy\" ON receipts;\n\n-- 使用循环删除所有 receipts 策略（确保删除干净）\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'receipts') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON receipts';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第三步：删除所有 receipt_items 策略\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipt_items_select\" ON receipt_items;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipt_items_insert\" ON receipt_items;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipt_items_update\" ON receipt_items;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipt_items_delete\" ON receipt_items;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can manage receipt items in their household\" ON receipt_items;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"receipt_items_manage_policy\" ON receipt_items;\n\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'receipt_items') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"' || r.policyname || '\" ON receipt_items';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第四步：重新创建 receipts 策略（使用更宽松的检查，避免 NULL 问题）\n-- SELECT: 用户可以查看自己家庭的小票",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表的 RLS 策略，允许查询同家庭的用户信息\n-- 解决所有查询用户信息时的权限问题\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：确保 get_user_household_id() 函数存在且正确\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    -- 优先使用 current_household_id\n    (SELECT current_household_id FROM users WHERE id = auth.uid()),\n    -- 如果为 NULL，从 user_households 表获取第一个家庭\n    (SELECT household_id FROM user_households WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1)\n  );\n$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- 第二步：删除所有现有的 users 表策略\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped policy: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第三步：重新创建 users 表的 RLS 策略\n\n-- SELECT: 允许用户查看同家庭的用户或自己\n-- 使用 user_households 表来检查是否在同一家庭\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_same_household\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT \n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    -- 允许查看自己（最重要，必须放在第一位）\n    id = auth.uid()\n    OR\n    -- 允许查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 \n      FROM user_households uh1\n      INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id = users.id\n    )\n  );\n\n-- INSERT: 允许用户创建自己的记录（注册时需要）\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_own_record\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT \n  TO authenticated\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- UPDATE: 用户只能更新自己的记录\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update_own_record\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "  USING (\n    -- 条件1：用户可以查看自己的记录（最基本的权限，必须放在第一位）\n    id = auth.uid() \n    -- 条件2：用户可以查看邀请者的信息（用于显示邀请对话框）\n    -- 如果当前用户有 pending 邀请，且该用户的 id 是邀请者（inviter_id）\n    -- 注意：使用 auth.users 表获取 email，避免递归查询 users 表\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT inviter_id \n      FROM household_invitations \n      WHERE invitee_email = (\n        SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n      )\n      AND status = 'pending'\n      AND expires_at \u003e NOW()\n    )\n    -- 条件3：用户可以查看同家庭的用户（通过 user_households 表）\n    -- 注意：不查询 users 表的 current_household_id，而是直接通过 user_households 表关联\n    -- 这个策略允许用户查看与自己同家庭的所有其他用户（用于显示家庭成员列表）\n    OR id IN (\n      SELECT uh2.user_id\n      FROM user_households uh1\n      JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n      WHERE uh1.user_id = auth.uid()\n        AND uh2.user_id != auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- 第三步：创建 users INSERT 策略\nCREATE POLICY \"users_insert_policy\" ON users\n  FOR INSERT \n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 第四步：创建 users UPDATE 策略\n-- 允许用户更新自己的记录（包括 current_household_id）\n-- 用于切换家庭时更新 current_household_id\nCREATE POLICY \"users_update_policy\" ON users\n  FOR UPDATE\n  USING (id = auth.uid())\n  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- 第五步：验证策略已创建\nSELECT \n    '✅ Policy created' as status,\n    tablename, \n    policyname, \n    cmd,\n    qual as using_clause\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\nORDER BY policyname;\n\n-- 第六步：验证 RLS 已启用\nSELECT \n    '✅ RLS status' as status,\n    tablename, \n    rowsecurity as rls_enabled\nFROM pg_tables \nWHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users';\n\n-- 说明：",

        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 正确修复：开放 users 表的权限策略\n-- 允许在 RLS 策略上下文中查询 users 表\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 第一步：检查当前的 users 表 RLS 策略\nSELECT \n    '=== 当前 users 表 RLS 策略 ===' as section,\n    policyname,\n    cmd,\n    roles,\n    qual as using_clause,\n    with_check,\n    CASE \n        WHEN cmd = 'SELECT' AND (\n            qual LIKE '%auth.uid()%' OR qual LIKE '%id = auth.uid()%'\n        ) THEN '✅ 允许查询自己的记录'\n        WHEN cmd = 'SELECT' AND qual IS NULL THEN '❌ 没有限制（可能不安全）'\n        ELSE '⚠️  需要检查'\n    END as status\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\nORDER BY cmd, policyname;\n\n-- 第二步：检查 get_user_household_id 函数（如果使用的话）\nSELECT \n    '=== get_user_household_id 函数 ===' as section,\n    routine_name,\n    security_type,\n    CASE \n        WHEN security_type = 'DEFINER' THEN '✅ 使用 SECURITY DEFINER（可以绕过 RLS）'\n        ELSE '⚠️  不使用 SECURITY DEFINER（可能受 RLS 限制）'\n    END as status,\n    SUBSTRING(routine_definition, 1, 200) as definition_preview\nFROM information_schema.routines\nWHERE routine_schema = 'public'\n  AND routine_name = 'get_user_household_id';\n\n-- 第三步：修复 get_user_household_id 函数（确保可以使用 SECURITY DEFINER 查询 users 表）\n-- 这是关键：如果函数使用 SECURITY DEFINER，它可以在自己的权限下查询 users 表\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_household_id()\nRETURNS UUID AS $$\n  -- 可以从 users 表获取（因为使用 SECURITY DEFINER，可以绕过 RLS）",

            "text": "    CASE "

            "text": "FROM information_schema.routines"

            "text": "WHERE routine_schema = 'public'"

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "CREATE POLICY \"receipts_manage\" ON receipts\n  FOR ALL\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    household_id IN (\n      SELECT household_id \n      FROM user_households \n      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  )\n  WITH CHECK (\n    household_id IN (\n      SELECT household_id \n      FROM user_households \n      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第十一部分：创建 receipt_items 表的 RLS 策略\n-- ============================================\n\n-- ALL: 用户可以管理自己所属家庭的小票项\nCREATE POLICY \"receipt_items_manage\" ON receipt_items\n  FOR ALL\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 \n      FROM receipts\n      WHERE receipts.id = receipt_items.receipt_id\n        AND receipts.household_id IN (\n          SELECT household_id \n          FROM user_households \n          WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n        )\n    )\n  )\n  WITH CHECK (\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 \n      FROM receipts\n      WHERE receipts.id = receipt_items.receipt_id\n        AND receipts.household_id IN (\n          SELECT household_id \n          FROM user_households \n          WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n        )\n    )\n  );\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第十二部分：创建 payment_account_merge_history 表的 RLS 策略\n-- ============================================\n\n-- ALL: 用户可以管理自己所属家庭的支付账户合并历史\nCREATE POLICY \"payment_account_merge_history_manage\" ON payment_account_merge_history\n  FOR ALL\n  TO authenticated\n  USING (\n    household_id IN (\n      SELECT household_id \n      FROM user_households \n      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  )\n  WITH CHECK (\n    household_id IN (\n      SELECT household_id \n      FROM user_households \n      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    )\n  );\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第十三部分：验证所有策略已创建\n-- ============================================\n\nSELECT \n    '=== 验证结果 ===' as section,\n    tablename,\n    cmd,",

        "contents": "BEGIN\n    -- 删除所有现有的 household_invitations SELECT 策略\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'household_invitations'\n          AND cmd = 'SELECT'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON household_invitations', r.policyname);\n    END LOOP;\n    \n    -- 创建新的 SELECT 策略\n    CREATE POLICY \"household_invitations_select\" ON household_invitations\n      FOR SELECT\n      TO authenticated\n      USING (\n        -- 用户可以查看自己收到的邀请（使用 auth.users，不需要查询 public.users）\n        invitee_email = (\n          SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()\n        )\n        OR\n        -- 用户可以查看自己所属家庭的邀请（使用 get_user_household_id() 函数）\n        household_id = get_user_household_id()\n        OR\n        -- 用户可以查看自己创建的邀请（直接比较，不查询任何表）\n        inviter_id = auth.uid()\n        OR\n        -- 或者通过 user_households 表查询\n        EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 \n          FROM user_households \n          WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n            AND household_id = household_invitations.household_id\n        )\n      );\n    \n    RAISE NOTICE '✅ 创建了新的 SELECT 策略';\nEND $$;\n\n-- 第五步：验证所有修复\nSELECT \n    '=== 验证结果 ===' as section,\n    'users 表 SELECT 策略' as policy_type,\n    policyname,\n    qual as policy_definition,\n    CASE \n        WHEN qual LIKE '%id = auth.uid()%' OR qual LIKE '%auth.uid()%' THEN '✅ 允许查询自己的记录'\n        ELSE '⚠️  需要检查'\n    END as status\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\n  AND cmd = 'SELECT'\n\nUNION ALL\n\nSELECT \n    '=== 验证结果 ===' as section,",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- ============================================\n-- 修复 users 表 RLS 策略，允许外键约束检查\n-- 原则：业务跑通为关键考量，数据安全为第二考虑\n-- ============================================\n\n-- 问题：外键约束检查时访问 users 表被 RLS 阻止\n-- 解决方案：放宽 users 表的 SELECT 策略，确保外键检查可以访问\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第一步：删除所有现有的 users 表 RLS 策略\n-- ============================================\n\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    RAISE NOTICE '=== 开始清理 users 表 RLS 策略 ===';\n    \n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT policyname \n        FROM pg_policies \n        WHERE schemaname = 'public' \n          AND tablename = 'users'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON users', r.policyname);\n        RAISE NOTICE '✅ 删除了策略: %', r.policyname;\n    END LOOP;\n    \n    RAISE NOTICE '✅ 所有 users 表 RLS 策略已清理完成';\nEND $$;\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 第二步：创建宽松的 SELECT 策略（允许外键检查）\n-- 原则：业务跑通为关键考量，数据安全为第二考虑\n-- ============================================\n\n-- SELECT: 允许查看自己的记录和同家庭的用户记录\n-- 关键：必须允许查看自己的记录（id = auth.uid()），这样外键检查才能通过\n-- 注意：外键约束检查时，PostgreSQL 需要能够访问被引用的表\n-- 因此必须确保 id = auth.uid() 的条件存在且优先\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT\n  TO authenticated",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "-- 修复 users 表 RLS 策略，允许外键约束检查"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "-- 原则：业务跑通为关键考量，数据安全为第二考虑"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "-- 问题：外键约束检查时访问 users 表被 RLS 阻止"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "-- 解决方案：放宽 users 表的 SELECT 策略，确保外键检查可以访问"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "-- 第一步：删除所有现有的 users 表 RLS 策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "-- ============================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "DO $$"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "DECLARE"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "    r RECORD;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "BEGIN"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "    RAISE NOTICE '=== 开始清理 users 表 RLS 策略 ===';"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "    "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "    FOR r IN ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "        SELECT policyname "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "        FROM pg_policies "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "        WHERE schemaname = 'public' "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "          AND tablename = 'users'"
          },
          {

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "-- 修复 users 表的 RLS SELECT 策略以支持多家庭系统\n-- 允许同一家庭的用户查看其他成员的email和name\n-- 在 Supabase SQL Editor 中执行此脚本\n\n-- 1. 创建函数：检查两个用户是否在同一家庭（使用 SECURITY DEFINER 避免递归）\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION users_in_same_household(p_current_user_id UUID, p_target_user_id UUID)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nLANGUAGE sql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\n  -- 检查两个用户是否有共同的家庭\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM user_households uh1\n    INNER JOIN user_households uh2 ON uh1.household_id = uh2.household_id\n    WHERE uh1.user_id = p_current_user_id\n      AND uh2.user_id = p_target_user_id\n  );\n$$;\n\n-- 2. 删除现有的 users SELECT 策略\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Users can view users in their household\" ON users;\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"users_select_policy\" ON users;\n\n-- 3. 创建新的 SELECT 策略：\n-- 用户可以查看同一家庭中所有成员的信息，或者自己的信息\nCREATE POLICY \"users_select_policy\" ON users\n  FOR SELECT USING (\n    -- 用户可以查看自己的记录\n    id = auth.uid()\n    OR\n    -- 或者用户可以查看同一家庭中其他成员的记录\n    -- 使用 SECURITY DEFINER 函数来检查，避免递归\n    users_in_same_household(auth.uid(), users.id)\n  );\n\n-- 5. 验证策略已创建\nSELECT \n    tablename, \n    policyname, \n    cmd,\n    qual,\n    with_check\nFROM pg_policies\nWHERE schemaname = 'public' \n  AND tablename = 'users'\n  AND policyname = 'users_select_policy';",

## 已修复的问题

### 问题 1：未移除的成员显示成 "removed"

### 原因说明

你说得对：当前流程里，同一张图片会被裁剪两次：

- 第一次：在原生扫描界面（`react-native-document-scanner-plugin`）里，用户已经手动/自动裁剪过。
- 第二次：代码里调用 `processImageForUpload(imageUri, { autoCrop: true })` 时，又做了一次自动裁剪，容易把票面进一步截断，导致识别不全。

### 已做的修改（已帮你改好代码）

在两个入口都做了区分：

1. **主页拍摄入口**：`app/index.tsx`
2. **小票列表中的重新拍摄入口**：`app/receipts.tsx`

关键调整：

- 给 `processCapturedImage` 加了一个参数 `autoCrop`，用于控制是否再做自动裁剪。
- **扫描得到的图片**（已经在扫描界面裁剪过）：
  - 现在调用时传 `false`，完全关闭二次裁剪。
- **从相册选择的图片**（通常没裁剪）：
  - 仍然传 `true`，保留自动裁剪逻辑，帮你去掉多余背景。

具体行为：

#### 在 `app/index.tsx`

```ts
// 扫描后的图片：不再自动裁剪
if (scannedImages && scannedImages.length > 0) {
  processCapturedImage(scannedImages[0], false);
}

// 从相册选择的图片：保留自动裁剪
if (!result.canceled && result.assets[0]) {
  processCapturedImage(result.assets[0].uri, true);
}

// 处理函数现在支持 autoCrop 参数，默认 true
const processCapturedImage = async (imageUri: string, autoCrop: boolean = true) => {
  const processedImageUri = await processImageForUpload(imageUri, {
    autoCrop,
    quality: 0.85,
  });
  // 后续上传 + 保存逻辑保持不变
};
```

#### 在 `app/receipts.tsx`

同样的逻辑也已经同步：

```ts
// 扫描后的图片：不再自动裁剪
if (scannedImages && scannedImages.length > 0) {
  processCapturedImage(scannedImages[0], false);
}

// 从相册选择的图片：保留自动裁剪
if (!result.canceled && result.assets[0]) {
  processCapturedImage(result.assets[0].uri, true);
}

// 处理函数
const processCapturedImage = async (imageUri: string, autoCrop: boolean = true) => {
  const processedImageUri = await processImageForUpload(imageUri, {
    autoCrop,
    quality: 0.85,
  });
  // 后续上传 + 保存逻辑保持不变
};
```

### 现在的效果

- **扫码 + 扫描界面裁剪后**：

### 已根据你提的 4 点完成修改

#### 1. 全局文案：Scan → Snap

- 将与拍摄相关的用户文案从 **Scan** 统一调整为 **Snap**（作为动词使用）：
  - `app/index.tsx` / `app/receipts.tsx` 中的错误提示：
    - `Failed to scan document...` → **`Failed to snap document...`**
  - `app.config.js` 中相机权限说明：
    - `"We need camera access to scan receipts."` → **`"We need camera access to snap receipts."`**

（文档里的 “Scan Document” 保留作为内部操作说明，如需也一起改，我可以再统一替换。）

---

#### 2. 去掉第一级“拍摄 / 选图”弹窗

- 在 `app/index.tsx` 里，原来的相机按钮逻辑是：

  ```ts
  const handleCameraPress = () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Scan Receipt',
      'Choose an option',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        { text: 'Scan Document', onPress: scanDocument },
        { text: 'Pick from Gallery', onPress: pickImage }
      ]
    );
  };
  ```

- 现在改为**直接进入拍摄界面**：

  ```ts
  const handleCameraPress = () => {
    // 直接进入拍摄界面（扫描界面内部已支持选择已有图片）
    scanDocument();
  };
  ```

- 即：点击首页大相机按钮，直接打开扫描界面；如果在 Expo Go 环境，则仍在 `scanDocument` 里弹出「Development Build Required / Pick from Gallery」的 Alert，不再多一层选择。

---

#### 3. 移除拍摄后的预览 / 多按钮操作

- 原来在 `app/index.tsx` 中，拍摄并保存后会出现一个 **Success Modal**，包含：
  - `Receipt Saved`
  - `Scan Another`
  - `View Details`
  - `View List`

- 现在已**完全移除这个 Success Modal 和相关状态**（`capturedReceiptId`）：
  - 不再弹出三选一的预览 / 跳转对话框。
  - 改为在保存成功后仅给出一个简单提示：

  ```ts
  setIsProcessing(false);
  Alert.alert('Receipt Saved', 'Processing in background...');
  ```

- 这样流程变为：
  - 拍摄 → 上传 → 入库 → 提示“已保存，后台处理中” → 用户继续在首页操作（如需要可自行去 Receipts 页面看列表）。

---

#### 4. 自动裁剪范围扩大一圈（保留小票纸张边缘）

自动裁剪只在我们自己的 `processImageForUpload` 中发生，所以我做了两层调整：

##### 4.1 对拍摄 / 选图入口区分是否需要自动裁剪

- 在 `app/index.tsx` 和 `app/receipts.tsx` 中，`processCapturedImage` 现在接受 `autoCrop` 参数：

  ```ts
  // app/index.tsx
  const processCapturedImage = async (imageUri: string, autoCrop: boolean = true) => {
    const processedImageUri = await processImageForUpload(imageUri, {
      autoCrop,
      quality: 0.85,
    });
    ...
  };
  ```

- 使用方式：

  - **扫描得到的图片**（在原生 DocumentScanner 里已经裁剪过）：

    ```ts
    if (scannedImages && scannedImages.length > 0) {
      // 不再做二次自动裁剪，避免再次截断
      processCapturedImage(scannedImages[0], false);
    }
    ```

  - **从相册选择的原始图片**（通常未裁剪）：

    ```ts
    if (!result.canceled && result.assets[0]) {
      // 对原始图片仍启用自动裁剪，去掉多余背景
      processCapturedImage(result.assets[0].uri, true);
    }
    ```

##### 4.2 调整自动裁剪算法的边距（扩大保留区域）

- 在 `lib/image-processor.ts` 中，`detectEdges` 和 `detectReceiptCorners` 使用统一的边距策略。
- 原来的边距比较激进，会截掉较多边缘：

  ```ts
  const baseMargin = 0.15; // 15%
  const minMargin = 0.10;  // 10%
  const maxMargin = 0.20;  // 20%
  ```

- 现在已调小边距，让**裁剪框更大一圈**、更多包含小票纸张边缘：

  ```ts
  // detectEdges / detectReceiptCorners 中统一改为：
  const baseMargin = 0.08; // 8%
  const minMargin = 0.05;  // 5%
  const maxMargin = 0.12;  // 12%
  ```

- 效果：
  - 自动裁剪时只从四边各缩进约 5–12%，而不是 10–20%；
  - 这样既能去掉大部分背景，又保留小票边缘一圈，减少“被切太紧、丢内容”的情况。

---

### 回顾你的 4 点需求对应关系

1. **Scan → Snap 文案统一**  
   - 已改 Alert 文案和权限提示里的 “scan” 为 “snap”。

2. **去掉点击按钮后的第一级选单**  
   - 首页相机按钮现在直接进入扫描界面，不再弹 “Scan Receipt / Scan Document / Pick from Gallery”。

3. **省去拍摄后的预览和进一步处理**  
   - 移除了 Success Modal 和多按钮选择，改为简单提示 Alert。

4. **自动裁剪范围扩大一圈**  
   - 扫描图片不再做二次自动裁剪；  
   - 对仍启用自动裁剪的场景（从相册选图），整体缩小裁剪边距到 5–12%。

---

如果你方便的话，可以用 APK 再拍几张典型票据测试一下（不同大小 / 不同边距），看现在的裁剪和识别是否更符合预期。如果还有具体例子（比如某种票据仍被切掉重要信息），可以描述一下，我可以再进一步微调裁剪参数。

---

现在已经按照你说的交互做完了：

- **主 `+` 按钮行为**：
  - 平时：右下角紫色大圆 `+` 按钮常驻。
  - 点击后：`+` 按钮本身立刻消失（不再渲染），只出现两个新按钮，并带有浮出动效。

- **两个新按钮**（大小与原 `+` 一致，都是 64x64，圆角 32）：
  - **下方按钮（扫描）**：
    - 位置：正好在原来 `+` 的位置。
    - 图标：相机 `camera`。
    - 动效：从原位置轻微渐显。
    - 点击：按钮组收回，然后进入 `scanDocument()`（拍照/扫码）。
  - **上方按钮（聊天录入）**：
    - 位置：从原 `+` 位置向上浮出一截（动画由 0 位移到向上约 80px）。
    - 图标：`chatbubble-outline`。
    - 动效：从原 `+` 位置向上浮出，同时渐显。
    - 点击：按钮组收回，然后跳转到 `voice-input` 聊天录入页。

- **收回逻辑**：
  - 再次点击主 `+`（展开状态下不会显示），是通过点击其中任意一个操作按钮后，先播放收回动画，再执行相应跳转/扫描。  

你可以在小票列表页试一下：先点击 `+` 看两个等大的按钮从同一位置浮出，然后点扫描/聊天，确认动画和位置是否符合你的感觉。

已经帮你把“聊天录入”的记录持久化并支持上滑加载历史，整体逻辑是：

- **进入聊天录入页时**：
  - 调用 `getChatLogsPaginated(20)` 从 `ai_chat_logs` 里拉取当前空间最近 20 条聊天日志。
  - 把每条日志还原成多条 `Message`：
    - 有 `prompt` → 作为用户消息。
    - 有 `responseData.receiptPreview` → 作为带预览卡片的系统消息。
    - 否则用 `response` 作为普通系统消息。
  - 只在**完全没有历史**时才显示原来的欢迎文案。

- **向上滚动时**：
  - 在 `ScrollView` 的 `onScroll` 中，当滚到顶部（`contentOffset.y <= 0`）且还有更多历史时：
    - 调用 `getChatLogsPaginated(20, oldestLoadedAt)` 继续取更早的 20 条。
    - 解析后插入到当前 `messages` 的**前面**，实现“上滑加载更多”。

- **每次点击发送**：
  - 原有流程（Gemini 解析 → `saveReceipt` → 预览卡片）保持不变。
  - 额外调用 `saveChatLog({...})` 把本轮的 `prompt` + 预览信息写入 `ai_chat_logs`，下次进入时会自动还原出来。

现在效果就是：用户每次进“聊天录入”都会看到最近几条自己的聊天和预览卡片，继续往上滑可以加载更早的记录。

**Adjusting receipt indicators**

I need to ensure that if a receipt is deleted, a "deleted" indicator shows up, and the details button should be hidden. The deletion process is an actual database delete, and our chat logs keep the receiptId but not its status. When we reload history, we pull the receiptPreview from responseData, which includes status from earlier. If a receipt is deleted later, we need to reflect that accurately in the UI by calling getReceiptById when rendering or on user interaction to update its status.
**Implementing dynamic receipt status**

I think we should check the receipt status before navigating or confirming. Here’s my implementation idea: I'll import getReceiptById from the database into voice-input.tsx. Then, I'll create a helper function called syncReceiptStatus(message) to fetch the receipt by ID. If the receipt isn't found, I'll mark message.receiptPreviewDeleted as true and set the status to 'deleted.' 

For rendering, I'll introduce local booleans, like isDeleted and isConfirmed, and adjust the JSX to show the View Details button only when it's not deleted. I'll make the right button show a disabled state if the receipt is deleted. However, our current ReceiptStatus type lacks this 'deleted' status, which complicates things.
**Considering receipt deletion handling**

I think the receipts table may have a 'deleted' state, but the type might be outdated. We shouldn't just extend the union without verifying. The user referenced the "已删除" state, so it might require a separate column, or we could treat non-existent receipts as deleted.

Instead of adding 'deleted' to ReceiptStatus, I’ll introduce a boolean `isDeleted` in the preview message, which I'll set when fetching the receipt fails. For the flow, we'll import getReceiptById and adjust the onPress callbacks for both the View Details and Confirm buttons. We’ll check for receipt existence and show an alert if the receipt has been deleted without navigating further. We'll also need to extend the Message interface to include `receiptDeleted?: boolean;`.
**Implementing receipt deletion logic**

For the details button, I need to check if the receipt ID exists. If it doesn't, I’ll try to fetch it using getReceiptById. If no receipt is found, I’ll mark it as deleted and alert the user that the receipt has been deleted. For the confirm button, I'll check if the message is marked as deleted before proceeding with any updates. 

To handle UI changes, I'll compute `isDeleted` from message.receiptDeleted and then wrap the View Details button based on that. For the Confirm button, if it’s deleted, I’ll show a disabled grey button with "Deleted" text.
**Restoring messages logic**

When restoring messages from chat logs, we initially won’t know if a receipt has been deleted. During the first interaction attempt, I'll mark it as deleted, which seems acceptable. I need to import getReceiptById into voice-input.tsx, but since it’s already imported from the path '@/lib/database', I just have to destructure it. I also have to be careful with applying patches, so I’ll make sure to implement that correctly. Let’s move forward with these modifications!</details></think>

已经按你的要求把聊天预览卡片和真实小票状态对上了：

- **删除状态识别**：
  - 预览 `Message` 结构里新增了 `receiptDeleted` 字段。
  - 点击预览卡片右下角任一按钮前，都会先用 `getReceiptById` 去 Supabase 查一下这张小票是否还存在。
  - 如果查不到或报错，就认为这张小票已被删除：在对应消息上标记 `receiptDeleted = true`。

- **按钮表现**：
  - **左侧 `View Details` 按钮**：当 `receiptDeleted` 为 true 时不再渲染，用户看不到详情入口。
  - **右下角按钮**：
    - 如果小票已删除：按钮变为灰色（`previewActionButtonDisabled`），图标为 `trash-outline`，文案显示 **Deleted**，点击只弹提示“Receipt Deleted”，不再做其他操作。
    - 如果未删除：
      - 已确认：绿色按钮、`checkmark-circle` 图标、文案 **Confirmed**，不可再点。
      - 未确认：紫色按钮、`checkmark-circle-outline` 图标、文案 **Confirm**，点击前再二次确认该小票仍存在，然后才更新为 `confirmed`。

这样，无论你是在小票列表里删除了记录，还是别的终端删掉了，再回到“聊天录入”窗口时，对应的预览卡片右下角按钮都会反映真实状态：已删就显示 Deleted，且不再有详情入口。

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import { getCurrentUser } from './auth';\nimport { findCategoryByName, getCategories } from './categories';\nimport { findPurposeByName, getPurposes } from './purposes';\nimport { findOrCreatePaymentAccount } from './payment-accounts';\nimport { findOrCreateSupplier } from './suppliers';\n\n// 将 Gemini 识别结果转换为 Receipt 格式\nexport async function convertGeminiResultToReceipt(result: GeminiReceiptResult): Promise\u003cReceipt\u003e {\n  const user = await getCurrentUser();\n  if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n  // 获取所有分类和用途\n  const categories = await getCategories();\n  const purposes = await getPurposes();\n\n  // 处理供应商（排除无效的供应商名称，如 \"Processing...\" 等）\n  let supplierId: string | undefined;\n  // Gemini API 返回的是 storeName，我们将其作为 supplierName 处理\n  const supplierName = result.storeName;\n  if (supplierName \u0026\u0026 supplierName.trim()) {\n    const trimmedSupplierName = supplierName.trim();\n    // 排除处理状态等无效名称\n    const invalidNames = ['processing', 'processing...', 'pending', 'pending...', 'loading', 'loading...', '识别中', '处理中', '待处理'];\n    const isValidName = !invalidNames.includes(trimmedSupplierName.toLowerCase());\n    \n    if (isValidName) {\n      try {\n        const supplier = await findOrCreateSupplier(\n          trimmedSupplierName,\n          true,\n          result.supplierInfo?.taxNumber,\n          result.supplierInfo?.phone,\n          result.supplierInfo?.address\n        );\n        supplierId = supplier.id;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('Failed to create or find supplier:', error);\n        // 如果供应商创建失败，继续处理其他信息，不阻塞整个流程\n      }\n    } else {\n      console.warn(&#96;Skipping invalid supplier name: \"${trimmedSupplierName}\"&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 处理支付账户\n  let paymentAccountId: string | undefined;\n  if (result.paymentAccountName) {\n    const account = await findOrCreatePaymentAccount(result.paymentAccountName, true);\n    paymentAccountId = account.id;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function saveReceipt(receipt: Receipt): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n\n    }\n\n    // 处理支付账户ID\n    let paymentAccountId = receipt.paymentAccountId;\n    if (!paymentAccountId \u0026\u0026 receipt.paymentAccount) {\n      const account = await findOrCreatePaymentAccount(receipt.paymentAccount.name || receipt.paymentAccount.id, true);\n      paymentAccountId = account.id;\n    }\n\n    // 先保存小票主记录\n    const { data: receiptData, error: receiptError } = await supabase\n      .from('receipts')\n      .insert({\n        space_id: spaceId,\n        supplier_name: receipt.supplierName || receipt.storeName,\n        supplier_id: supplierId,\n        total_amount: receipt.totalAmount,\n        currency: receipt.currency,\n        tax: receipt.tax,\n        date: receipt.date,\n        payment_account_id: paymentAccountId,\n        status: receipt.status,\n        image_url: receipt.imageUrl,\n        confidence: receipt.confidence,\n        processed_by: receipt.processedBy,\n        created_by: user.id, // 记录提交者\n      })\n      .select()\n      .single();\n\n    if (receiptError) {\n      console.error('Receipt insert error:', receiptError);\n}",

        "contents": "export async function saveReceipt(receipt: Receipt): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n {\n    console.error('Error saving receipt:', error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n// 更新小票\nexport async function updateReceipt(receiptId: string, receipt: Partial\u003cReceipt\u003e): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    // 处理供应商ID（排除无效的供应商名称，如 \"Processing...\" 等）\n    let supplierId = receipt.supplierId;\n    const supplierName = receipt.supplierName || receipt.storeName; // 向后兼容\n    if (supplierName \u0026\u0026 !supplierId) {\n      const trimmedSupplierName = supplierName.trim();\n      // 排除处理状态等无效名称\n      const invalidNames = ['processing', 'processing...', 'pending', 'pending...', 'loading', 'loading...', '识别中', '处理中', '待处理'];\n      const isValidName = !invalidNames.includes(trimmedSupplierName.toLowerCase());\n\n      if (isValidName) {\n        try {\n          // 如果更新了 storeName 但没有 supplierId，尝试查找或创建供应商\n          const supplier = await findOrCreateSupplier(trimmedSupplierName, true);\n          supplierId = supplier.id;\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.warn('Failed to create or find supplier:', error);\n          // 如果供应商创建失败，继续处理其他信息，不阻塞整个流程\n        }\n      } else {\n        console.warn(&#96;Skipping invalid supplier name: \"${trimmedSupplierName}\"&#96;);\n      }\n    } else if (receipt.supplier \u0026\u0026 !supplierId) {\n      // 如果有 supplier 对象，使用其 ID\n      supplierId = receipt.supplier.id;\n    }\n\n    // 处理支付账户ID\n    let paymentAccountId = receipt.paymentAccountId;\n    if (!paymentAccountId \u0026\u0026 receipt.paymentAccount) {\n      const account = await findOrCreatePaymentAccount(receipt.paymentAccount.name || receipt.paymentAccount.id, true);\n      paymentAccountId = account.id;\n    }\n\n    // 更新小票主记录\n    const updateData: any = {};\n    if (receipt.supplierName !== undefined) updateData.supplier_name = receipt.supplierName;\n    else if (receipt.storeName !== undefined)\n}",

        "contents": "export interface DataConsistency {\n // 一致性评价文字\n}\n\n// Gemini识别结果（使用分类名称，后续会匹配到分类ID）\nexport interface GeminiReceiptResult {\n  storeName: string;\n  supplierInfo?: {\n    taxNumber?: string; // 税号\n    phone?: string; // 电话\n    address?: string; // 地址\n  };\n  date: string;\n  totalAmount: number;\n  currency?: string; // 币种，如：CNY、USD\n  paymentAccountName?: string; // 支付账户，包含卡号尾号信息\n  tax?: number; // 税费\n  items: Array\u003c{\n    name: string;\n    categoryName: string; // 分类名称，从[食品,外餐, 居家, 交通, 购物, 医疗, 教育]中选择\n    price: number;\n    purposeName?: string; // 用途名称，将映射到 purposes.name\n    isAsset?: boolean; // 可选\n    confidence?: number; // 可选\n  }\u003e;\n  confidence?: number; // 可选，整体识别置信度 0-1\n  imageQuality?: ImageQuality; // 图片质量评价\n  dataConsistency?: DataConsistency; // 数据一致性检查\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export async function convertGeminiResultToReceipt(result: GeminiReceiptResult): Promise\u003cReceipt\u003e {\nconst items = await \nasync (item) =\u003e {\n {\n          category = categories[0];\n          console.warn(&#96;使用第一个可用分类: ${category.name}&#96;);\n        }\n        \n        if (!category) {\n          throw new Error(\n            'Default category not found.\\n\\n' +\n            'Please do one of the following:\\n' +\n            '1. Execute add-default-categories-for-existing-users.sql in Supabase SQL Editor\\n' +\n            '2. Or manually create at least one category in the app\\n\\n' +\n            'Current user space ID: ' + (user.spaceId || 'Unknown')\n          );\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 匹配用途\n      let purposeId: string | null = null;\n      if (item.purposeName) {\n        const purpose = purposes.find(p =\u003e p.name.toLowerCase() === item.purposeName!.toLowerCase())\n          || await findPurposeByName(item.purposeName);\n        if (purpose) {\n          purposeId = purpose.id;\n        }\n      }\n\n      return {\n        name: item.name,\n        categoryId: category.id,\n        category: category,\n        purposeId,\n        price: item.price,\n        isAsset: item.isAsset || false, // 默认值为 false\n        confidence: item.confidence,\n      };\n    })\n  );\n\n  // 计算调整后的置信度（基于多个因素）\n  let adjustedConfidence = result.confidence || 0.5;\n  \n  // 1. 检查明细金额总和与总金额是否一致\n  const itemsSum = items.reduce((sum, item) =\u003e sum + item.price, 0);\n  const expectedTotal = itemsSum + (result.tax || 0);\n  const totalAmount = result.totalAmount || 0;\n  const amountDifference = Math.abs(expectedTotal - totalAmount);\n  const amountMatches = amountDifference \u003c= 0.01; // 允许 0.01 的误差\n  \n  // 2. 检查数据一致性\n  const dataConsistency = result.dataConsistency;\n  const itemsSumMatches = dataConsistency?.itemsSumMatchesTotal ?? amountMatches;\n  const hasMissingItems = dataConsistency?.missingItems ?? (!amountMatches \u0026\u0026 itemsSum \u003c totalAmount);\n  \n  // 3. 检查图片质量\n  const imageQuality = result.imageQuality;\n  const clarity = imageQuality?.clarity ?? 0.8;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export async function mergeSupplier(\n  sourceSupplierIds: string[],\n  targetSupplierId: string\n): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n\n    }\n\n    // 对每个源供应商执行合并操作\n    for (const sourceSupplierId of sourceSupplierIds) {\n      const sourceSupplier = allSuppliers.find(supplier =\u003e supplier.id === sourceSupplierId);\n      if (!sourceSupplier) continue;\n\n      // 更新所有使用源供应商的小票，将它们指向目标供应商\n      const { error: updateError } = await supabase\n        .from('receipts')\n        .update({ supplier_id: targetSupplierId })\n        .eq('supplier_id', sourceSupplierId)\n        .eq('space_id', spaceId);\n\n      if (updateError) throw updateError;\n\n      // 如果目标供应商缺少某些信息，尝试从源供应商补充\n      const updates: any = {};\n      if (!targetSupplier.tax_number \u0026\u0026 sourceSupplier.tax_number) {\n        updates.taxNumber = sourceSupplier.tax_number;\n      }\n      if (!targetSupplier.phone \u0026\u0026 sourceSupplier.phone) {\n        updates.phone = sourceSupplier.phone;\n      }\n      if (!targetSupplier.address \u0026\u0026 sourceSupplier.address) {\n        updates.address = sourceSupplier.address;\n      }\n      if (Object.keys(updates).length \u003e 0) {\n        await updateSupplier(targetSupplierId, updates);\n      }\n\n      // 记录合并历史（保存源供应商的原始名称）\n      const { error: historyError } = await supabase\n        .from('supplier_merge_history')\n        .insert({\n          space_id: spaceId,\n          source_supplier_name: sourceSupplier.name,\n          target_supplier_id: targetSupplierId,\n        });\n\n      if (historyError) {\n        console.warn('Failed to record merge history:', historyError);\n        // 不阻止合并操作，只记录警告\n      }\n\n      // 删除源供应商\n      const { error: deleteError } = await supabase\n        .from('suppliers')\n        .delete()\n        .eq('id', sourceSupplierId)\n        .eq('space_id', spaceId);\n\n      if (deleteError) throw deleteError;\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error merging supplier:', error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n// 获取合并历史记录（用于查找应该自动归并的供应商）\nasync function getMergeHistory(): Promise\u003cMap\u003cstring, string\u003e\u003e {\n  try\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import { supabase } from './supabase';\nimport { Receipt, ReceiptItem, ReceiptStatus } from '@/types';\nimport { getCurrentUser } from './auth';\nimport { findCategoryByName } from './categories';\nimport { findOrCreatePaymentAccount } from './payment-accounts';\nimport { findOrCreateSupplier } from './suppliers';\n\n// 将日期数据转换为 YYYY-MM-DD 格式的字符串，完全忠实于票面日期，不做任何时区转换\nfunction normalizeDate(dateValue: any): string {\n  if (!dateValue) {\n    // 如果日期为空，返回今天的日期（使用本地时区）\n    const today = new Date();\n    const year = today.getFullYear();\n    const month = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\n    const day = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n    return &#96;${year}-${month}-${day}&#96;;\n  }\n\n  // 优先处理字符串，因为这是数据库 DATE 字段的原始格式\n  if (typeof dateValue === 'string') {\n    // 如果是 ISO 字符串（如 \"2024-01-15T00:00:00Z\"），只取日期部分，不进行时区转换\n    if (dateValue.includes('T')) {\n      return dateValue.split('T')[0];\n    }\n    // 如果已经是 YYYY-MM-DD 格式，直接返回，不做任何转换\n    if (/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/.test(dateValue)) {\n      return dateValue;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 如果是 Date 对象，需要小心处理时区问题\n  // 为了避免时区转换问题，我们使用 UTC 方法而不是本地时区方法\n  // 这样可以确保日期与数据库存储的日期一致\n  if (dateValue instanceof Date) {\n    // 使用 UTC 方法，确保与数据库 DATE 字段的存储方式一致\n    // PostgreSQL DATE 类型不包含时区信息，总是按字面值存储\n    const year = dateValue.getUTCFullYear();\n    const month = String(dateValue.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\n    const day = String(dateValue.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n    return &#96;${year}-${month}-${day}&#96;;\n  }\n\n  // 其他情况，尝试转换为字符串\n  return String(dateValue);\n}\n\n// 保存小票到数据库\nexport async function saveReceipt(receipt: Receipt): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n  try\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// 根据名称查找或创建供应商（用于AI识别）\nexport async function findOrCreateSupplier(\n  name: string,\n  isAiRecognized: boolean = true,\n  taxNumber?: string,\n  phone?: string,\n  address?: string\n): Promise\u003cSupplier\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    const trimmedName = name.trim();\n    if (!trimmedName || !isValidSupplierName(trimmedName)) {\n      throw new Error('Invalid supplier name: Supplier name cannot be empty or a processing status');\n    }\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) throw new Error('No space selected');\n\n    // 获取所有供应商\n    const { data: allSuppliers, error: fetchError } = await supabase\n      .from('suppliers')\n      .select('*')\n      .eq('space_id', spaceId);\n\n    if (fetchError) throw fetchError;\n\n    // 如果没有现有商家，直接创建\n    if (!allSuppliers || allSuppliers.length === 0) {\n      return await createSupplier(trimmedName, isAiRecognized, taxNumber, phone, address);\n    }\n\n    const normalizedName = normalizeSupplierName(trimmedName);\n\n    // 0. 优先检查合并历史记录（用户手动合并的商家应自动归并）\n    const mergeHistory = await getMergeHistory();\n    const mergedTargetId = mergeHistory.get(normalizedName);\n    if (mergedTargetId) {\n      const mergedSupplier = allSuppliers.find;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// 创建供应商\nexport async function createSupplier(\n  name: string,\n  isAiRecognized: boolean = false,\n  taxNumber?: string,\n  phone?: string,\n  address?: string\n): Promise\u003cSupplier\u003e {\n  try {\n    const user = await getCurrentUser();\n    if (!user) throw new Error('Not logged in');\n\n    // 优先使用 currentSpaceId，如果没有则使用 spaceId（向后兼容）\n    const spaceId = user.currentSpaceId || user.spaceId;\n    if (!spaceId) throw new Error('No space selected');\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('suppliers')\n      .insert({\n        space_id: spaceId,\n        name: name.trim(),\n        tax_number: taxNumber?.trim() || null,\n        phone: phone?.trim() || null,\n        address: address?.trim() || null,\n        is_ai_recognized: isAiRecognized,\n      })\n      .select()\n      .single();\n\n    if (error) throw error;\n\n    return {\n      id: data.id,\n      spaceId: data.space_id,\n      name: data.name,\n      taxNumber: data.tax_number,\n      phone: data.phone,\n      address: data.address,\n      isAiRecognized: data.is_ai_recognized,\n      createdAt: data.created_at,\n      updatedAt: data.updated_at,\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error creating supplier:', error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n// 更新供应商\nexport async function updateSupplier(\n  supplierId: string,\n  updates: {\n    name?: string;\n    taxNumber?: string;\n    phone?: string;\n    address?: string;\n  }\n): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "export async function getAllReceipts(): Promise\u003cReceipt[]\u003e {\nconst { data, error } = await \n('created_at', { ascending: false })\n      .order('created_at', { foreignTable: 'receipt_items', ascending: true });\n\n    if (error) throw error;\n\n    return (data || []).map((row: any) =\u003e ({\n      id: row.id,\n      spaceId: row.space_id,\n      supplierName: row.supplier_name,\n      storeName: row.supplier_name, // 向后兼容\n      supplierId: row.supplier_id,\n      supplier: row.suppliers ? {\n        id: row.suppliers.id,\n        spaceId: row.suppliers.space_id,\n        name: row.suppliers.name,\n        taxNumber: row.suppliers.tax_number,\n        phone: row.suppliers.phone,\n        address: row.suppliers.address,\n        isAiRecognized: row.suppliers.is_ai_recognized,\n        createdAt: row.suppliers.created_at,\n        updatedAt: row.suppliers.updated_at,\n      } : undefined,\n      totalAmount: row.total_amount,\n      currency: row.currency,\n      tax: row.tax,\n      date: normalizeDate(row.date),\n      paymentAccountId: row.payment_account_id,\n      paymentAccount: row.payment_accounts ? {\n        id: row.payment_accounts.id,\n        spaceId: row.payment_accounts.space_id,\n        name: row.payment_accounts.name,\n        isAiRecognized: row.payment_accounts.is_ai_recognized,\n        createdAt: row.payment_accounts.created_at,\n        updatedAt: row.payment_accounts.updated_at,\n      } : undefined,\n      status: row.status as ReceiptStatus,\n      imageUrl: row.image_url,\n      confidence: row.confidence,\n      processedBy: row.processed_by,\n      createdAt: row.created_at,\n      updatedAt: row.updated_at,\n      createdBy: row.created_by,\n      createdByUser: row.created_by_user ? {\n        id: row.created_by_user.id,\n        email: row.created_by_user.email,\n        name: row.created_by_user.name\n)\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// 后台处理小票识别的模块\nimport { recognizeReceipt } from './gemini';\nimport { convertGeminiResultToReceipt } from './receipt-helpers';\nimport { updateReceipt, getReceiptById } from './database';\nimport { uploadReceiptImage, supabase } from './supabase';\nimport { checkDuplicateReceipt } from './receipt-duplicate-checker';\n\n// 从公共URL中提取文件路径\nfunction extractFilePathFromUrl(url: string): string | null {\n  try {\n    const STORAGE_BUCKET = 'receipts';\n    // URL 格式通常是: https://[project].supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/receipts/[filename]\n    const urlObj = new URL(url);\n    const pathParts = urlObj.pathname.split('/');\n    const bucketIndex = pathParts.indexOf(STORAGE_BUCKET);\n    if (bucketIndex !== -1 \u0026\u0026 bucketIndex + 1 \u003c pathParts.length) {\n      // 提取 bucket 后面的所有路径部分（文件名可能包含目录结构）\n      const fileName = pathParts.slice(bucketIndex + 1).join('/');\n      return fileName;\n    }\n    return null;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error extracting file path from URL:', error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n// 删除临时文件\nasync function deleteTempFile(imageUrl: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n  try\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// 后台处理小票识别（不阻塞用户界面）\nexport async function processReceiptInBackground(\n  imageUrl: string,\n  receiptId: string,\n  processedImageUri: string\n): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n  try {\n    console.log('开始后台处理小票识别...', receiptId);\n    console.log('使用处理后的图片进行识别，URL:', imageUrl);\n    console.log('处理后的图片本地 URI:', processedImageUri);\n    \n    // 1. 使用处理后的图片 URL 识别小票（imageUrl 已经是处理后的图片）\n    const recognizedData = await recognizeReceipt(imageUrl);\n    console.log('识别完成，开始转换数据...');\n\n    // 2. 转换为 Receipt 格式（匹配分类和支付账户）\n    const receipt = await convertGeminiResultToReceipt(recognizedData);\n    console.log('数据转换完成，开始更新小票...');\n\n    // 3. 使用真实ID重新上传处理后的图片（替换临时文件）\n    // 注意：processedImageUri 是预处理后的图片本地 URI，不是原始图片\n    const finalImageUrl = await uploadReceiptImage(processedImageUri, receiptId);\n    console.log('最终处理后的图片已上传，URL:', finalImageUrl);\n\n    // 4. 删除临时文件（如果存在）- 使用 try-catch 确保失败不影响主流程\n    if (imageUrl \u0026\u0026 imageUrl !== finalImageUrl) {\n      console.log('删除临时文件:', imageUrl);\n      await deleteTempFile(imageUrl);\n    }\n\n    // 5. 更新小票数据（使用已存在的 receiptId）\n    // 状态已根据置信度在 convertGeminiResultToReceipt 中自动设置\n    await updateReceipt(receiptId, {\n      ...receipt,\n      imageUrl: finalImageUrl,\n      confidence: recognizedData.confidence,\n    });\n    \n    // 6. 检测是否与已有小票重复\n    const updatedReceipt = await getReceiptById(receiptId);\n    if (updatedReceipt) {\n      const duplicateReceipt = await checkDuplicateReceipt(updatedReceipt);\n}",
        "detailedLines": [
          {

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export default function VoiceInputScreen() {\n() =\u003e {\nconst loadInitialHistory = async \n\n\n        for (const log of sorted) {\n          // 用户输入\n          if (log.prompt) {\n            restoredMessages.push({\n              id: &#96;${log.id}-prompt&#96;,\n              text: log.prompt,\n              isUser: true,\n              timestamp: new Date(log.createdAt),\n            });\n          }\n\n          // 系统回复 + 预览卡片\n          if (log.responseData?.receiptPreview) {\n            const preview = log.responseData.receiptPreview as Receipt;\n            restoredMessages.push({\n              id: &#96;${log.id}-preview&#96;,\n              text: 'I\\'ve extracted the receipt details:',\n              isUser: false,\n              timestamp: new Date(log.createdAt),\n              receiptPreview: preview,\n            });\n          } else if (log.response) {\n            restoredMessages.push({\n              id: &#96;${log.id}-response&#96;,\n              text: log.response,\n              isUser: false,\n              timestamp: new Date(log.createdAt),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n\n        if (restoredMessages.length === 0) {\n          // 兜底：如果没有任何可还原的消息，也展示欢迎文案一次\n          setMessages([\n            {\n              id: 'welcome',\n              text:\n                'Hi! I can help you create receipts from text. Just describe your purchase, and I\\'ll extract the details.\\n\\nExample: \"I spent $25.50 at Starbucks on March 15th, 2024. Items: Coffee $5.50, Sandwich $20.00\"',\n              isUser: false,\n              timestamp: new Date(),\n            },\n          ]);\n          setHasMoreHistory(false);\n        } else {\n          // 加载时就根据真实小票状态，预先打上已删除 / 已确认等标记\n          const enriched = await Promise.all(\n            restoredMessages.map(async (msg) =\u003e {\n              if (!msg.receiptPreview?.id) return msg;\n              try {\n                const receipt = await getReceiptById(msg.receiptPreview.id);\n                if (!receipt) {\n                  return { ...msg, receiptDeleted: true };\n                }\n                return {\n                  ...msg,\n                  receiptPreview: {\n                    ...msg.receiptPreview,\n                    status: receipt.status as ReceiptStatus,\n                  },\n                  receiptDeleted: false,\n                }\n            }\n;\n;\n  }\n}",
